Title: Assistant Manager - Pouching
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Pouching Department

**Department:**Production – Pouching  
**Reports To:**Production Manager / Plant Head

1. Job PurposeTo manage and control all pouching operations to achieve production targets, optimum machine utilization, required quality standards, on-time delivery, minimum wastage, and efficient manpower utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and company procedures.2. Key Responsibilities**A. Production Planning and Execution**

* Execute daily and monthly production plans as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimum utilization of pouching machines, manpower, and available resources.
* Monitor production output, machine speeds, efficiency, downtime, and order completion.
* Ensure timely changeovers, job preparation, and smooth production flow.
* Coordinate with Planning, Printing, Lamination, Slitting, QA, Maintenance, departments.
* Take corrective action to recover production losses and meet daily targets.

**B. Productivity and Cost Control**

* Achieve defined targets for output, productivity, machine utilization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), where applicable.
* Minimize material wastage, start-up rejection, sealing defects, and pouching losses.
* Monitor production performance against established standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Improve machine running speeds and reduce setup, changeover, and idle time.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase capacity and reduce conversion costs.

**C. Quality Management**

* Ensure production conforms to approved specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters such as sealing temperature, pressure, dwell time, registration, dimensions, zipper alignment, gusset formation, and cutting accuracy, as applicable to the pouch type.
* Ensure first-piece approval and regular in-process quality checks.
* Prevent defects such as seal leakage, wrinkles, misregistration, poor cutting, contamination, and dimensional variation.
* Ensure traceability, correct material identification, and proper recording of production and quality data.
* Coordinate with QA to investigate non-conformities, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure rejected and non-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled.

**D. Manpower Management**

* Allocate operators and helpers according to machine loading and production priorities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operator performance.
* Develop operator skills through training, coaching, and competency assessments.
* Ensure proper shift handover and effective communication between shifts.
* Build a multi-skilled workforce to improve operational flexibility.

**E. Machine Maintenance and Performance**

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor recurring breakdowns and implement measures to reduce downtime.
* Ensure machines, tools, sealing jaws, cutting systems, and other accessories are maintained in good working condition.
* Ensure proper machine settings, changeover practices, and equipment handling.
* Report technical issues and recommend improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**F. Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company safety rules, machine guarding, and lockout/tagout procedures where applicable.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, and cleanliness throughout the department.
* Ensure safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment.
* Promote a safety-first culture and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, food-contact packaging, hygiene, and customer requirements.

**G. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily production and shift performance reports.
* Monitor output, efficiency, downtime, wastage, rejection, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure accurate recording of production data in ERP systems.
* Analyze performance gaps and submit action plans to the Production Manager.
* Maintain records of machine settings, quality checks, changeovers, downtime, and material reconciliation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated against approved departmental targets for:

* Production output versus plan.
* Machine efficiency and utilization.
* Downtime and breakdown losses.
* Material wastage and rejection percentage.
* Quality defects and customer complaints.
* On-time order completion.
* Setup and changeover time.
* Manpower productivity and overtime control.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Safety, housekeeping, and audit compliance.
* ERP data accuracy and timely reporting.
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction.

4. Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* 12-15 years of experience in pouching department experience; out of which 3 to 4 yrs as pouching in charge or AM pouching
* Experience in operating and managing pouching machines for different pouch formats, such as three-side seal, centre seal, stand-up pouch, zipper pouch, flat bottom 3 D pouch , quad pouch and other applicable formats.
* Knowledge of flexible packaging materials, laminates, sealing characteristics, pouch specifications, and defect analysis.
* Experience in production planning, manpower management, troubleshooting, quality control, and productivity improvement.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, production reporting, Excel, and root-cause analysis.

5. Required Competencies

* Strong production planning and execution skills.
* Leadership and manpower management.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Knowledge of pouching technology, process parameters and various pouching machine tools for all purposes.
* Focus on quality, productivity, waste reduction, and cost control.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional departments.
* Accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement mindset.

6. Authority and Accountability

* Allocate manpower and machines according to the approved production plan.
* Adjust machine settings within approved process specifications.
* Stop production when critical quality or safety issues are identified.
* Escalate material shortages, major breakdowns, quality deviations, and delivery risks.
* Recommend process improvements, training, and maintenance interventions.
* Accountable for departmental production performance, product quality, wastage, safety, and manpower utilization.

**Overall Accountability: To** ensure safe, efficient, cost-effective, and quality-compliant pouching operations while consistently achieving production and delivery targets.

Pay: AED7,500.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.

----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Title: Assistant Health & Safety Manager
Description:
WHAT ARE WE ABOUT?
  
At Salit Steel, we believe that people are our most valuable asset and that everyone on our team plays a unique role in contributing to our overall success. We are an integrated network of companies and partners that delivers steel solutions across North America. Now in our fifth generation, we have been family-owned and operated since 1905, and we consider our customers, industry partners, and employees to be part of the Salit Steel family. Headquartered in Niagara Falls, Ontario, we have operations across Ontario, Quebec, Western Canada, and the US, providing steel service centre solutions and reinforcing products, including stock and fabricated rebar, as well as specialty products such as assembled rebar, stainless steel rebar, and mechanical tube.
  
  
WHY JOIN US?
  
A values-driven, team-oriented environment – we are like a family
  
Competitive salary and benefits with RRSP matching
  
Opportunities for growth and development
  
A fun place to work!
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Assistant Health & Safety Manager leads the overall health and safety strategy and programs across all steel fabrication facilities and active construction sites (including high-rise residential, institutional, and infrastructure projects). You will drive continuous improvement across our operations in Ontario and Quebec to maintain an effective, safe, healthy, and productive work environment for all employees, contractors, customers, and visitors.
  
  
In this role, you will minimize operational risk, workplace injuries, and occupational health hazards while embedding a culture where safety is a shared responsibility across every level of the organization.
  
  
**Succession Plan Opportunity:** This position is strategically structured as a succession role. The successful candidate will work directly alongside current leadership with a clear, defined pathway to transition into the Health & Safety Manager role.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Strategic Leadership & Culture Creation
  
  

* Drive a company-wide safety culture where safety is an active, shared onus for every employee, empowering teams to identify hazards and stop unsafe work.
* Formulate, implement, and evaluate annual safety goals, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and Safe Work Practices through regular audits.
* Coach and empower plant managers, shop supervisors, and construction site superintendents to lead safety talks, site inspections, and transparent hazard reporting.

Regulatory Compliance & Operations Oversight
  
  

* Ensure total compliance with the Ontario Occupational Health and Safety Act (Industrial and Construction Regulations), Quebec CNESST / LSTT standards, WHMIS 2015, and CSA standards.
* Act as the primary technical safety liaison for regulatory bodies, including the Ontario Ministry of Labour (MLITSD) and Quebec CNESST.
* Lead efforts to achieve, maintain, and audit safety certifications (such as COR) and manage third-party compliance accounts (ISNetworld, Avetta, ComplyWorks).
* Oversee site-specific safety plans (SSSPs), job hazard analyses (JHAs), and safety documentation for major construction bids and kick-off meetings.

Risk Management, Incident Control & Claims Support
  
  

* Oversee hazard assessments and hierarchy-of-controls for high-risk operations (overhead cranes, rebar rigging, working at heights, lockout/tagout).
* Direct root-cause incident investigations for critical injuries and high-potential near-misses, implementing business-wide corrective actions.
* Partner with the Disability & Claims Manager on injury management, providing investigation details and technical safety context for WSIB/CNESST claims and Early & Safe Return to Work programs.

Training, Governance & Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and direct the Health & Safety Coordinator, setting priorities and evaluating performance.
* Oversee safety training modules (Fall Protection, Overhead Crane & Hoist, Heavy Rigging, First Aid, Supervisor Competency) and audit the master training matrix.
* Provide operational governance for Joint Health and Safety Committees (JHSCs) and Site Safety Representatives across all locations.
* Regularly travel to fabrication plants and active job sites to perform safety audits and maintain consistent standards.

Qualifications & Experience
  

* 10+ years of progressive H&S leadership experience within construction, steel fabrication, heavy manufacturing, or industrial environments.
* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* Certifications: NCSO (National Construction Safety Officer) or CRSP (Canadian Registered Safety Professional) preferred; COR Auditor certification is a strong asset.
* Proven track record managing multi-site safety across both fixed manufacturing plants and active civil/structural/high-rise construction sites.
* Strong expertise in Behaviour-Based Safety (BBS) programs, job hazard analyses, and crane/rigging safety standards.
* Working knowledge of WSIB and CNESST processes to effectively assist internal claims specialists.
* Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to influence, coach, and build trust across all levels of the workforce.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel up to 50% across facilities and active job sites.

Title: Senior Construction Project Manager
Description:
**About Plexcon Construction**

Plexcon Construction Inc. (plexcon.ca) is a fast-growing residential builder specializing in multiplex conversions, new multiplex builds, laneway and garden suites, additions and major renovations across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Our clients bring their own architect and design; we build it, from pre-construction to handover. We run about 15 active projects.

As our portfolio and management team continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead our Project Managers and make sure every project is properly planned, bought out, scheduled, documented and delivered within budget.

This is not an office-administration position, and it is not a site superintendent position.

We are looking for an experienced construction professional who understands how projects are built, can identify problems before they escalate, and has the authority and judgment to hold Project Managers accountable.

**Position Overview**

You lead our construction division and report directly to Ownership. Our Project Managers each run three to four projects hands-on, on site and in Procore, and they all report to you. You do not run projects of your own. You work primarily from the office and stay actively involved in the field.

You will be the central point between Ownership, Project Managers, Estimating, Accounting, subcontractors, consultants and clients, and you will make sure:

* Every trade is properly scoped, priced and under contract before it starts.
* Every project finishes within its budget.
* Project schedules are accurate and updated.
* Project Managers complete their commitments.
* Delays, cost risks and client concerns are identified early.
* Project records and compliance documents are complete.
* Company procedures are consistently followed.
* Ownership receives clear and accurate project reporting.

The right candidate will not simply report problems. They will challenge assumptions, develop solutions, assign responsibility and make sure corrective actions are completed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Trades, Scopes and Contracts**

* Receive the budget for each project by line item and trade category.
* Define the scope of work for every trade on every project.
* Source, pre-qualify and price subcontractors and suppliers; level bids and negotiate price and terms.
* Sign all subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Hand each trade to the project's PM with a clear scope, price and dates, so the PM can run the site without gaps.
* Make sure no subcontractor starts without a signed agreement, WSIB clearance certificate, certificate of insurance and Form 1000; maintain a central compliance tracker and monitor expiry dates.
* Track subcontractor performance on quality, reliability, scheduling, pricing, safety and deficiency response; maintain approved and restricted subcontractor lists.
* Monitor original contract values, approved changes and remaining balances; resolve scope gaps and contract disputes.
* Build a reliable subcontractor and supplier network.

**Budget and Cost Control**

* Be accountable for every project finishing within budget.
* Buy out each project at or under the line-item budget.
* Review job-cost, committed-cost and cost-to-complete reports with PMs; identify overruns and margin risks early and require corrective plans.
* Review and approve every client change order before it is sent to the client, and every subcontractor extra before the work proceeds; prevent unauthorized verbal commitments.
* Make sure costs are assigned to the correct projects and categories, and that approved cost and scope changes are communicated to Accounting.
* Confirm invoices match the approved contract and completed work before payment; recommend full approval, partial approval, holdback or rejection. Final payment processing remains with the Financial Controller and Ownership.

**Project Manager Leadership and Accountability**

* Directly supervise all Project Managers; assign projects and balance workload.
* Establish clear weekly priorities and performance expectations.
* Lead the weekly Project Manager operations meeting and regular project reviews with each PM.
* Hold PMs accountable for schedules, budgets, procurement, documentation, client communication and site performance.
* Train and coach PMs on planning, communication, subcontractor management and problem-solving; be their first call for questions on scope, trades, drawings, cost or clients.
* Require recovery plans for troubled projects and step in before issues become major delays, disputes or financial losses.
* Check that commitments and action items were actually completed; identify recurring performance problems, missed deadlines and weak follow-up.
* Escalate serious project or performance concerns to Ownership.
* Assist with interviewing, onboarding, training and evaluating PMs.

**Portfolio and Project Oversight**

* Maintain an accurate overview of every active project: stage, schedule, financial risks, client issues and outstanding decisions.
* Make sure every project has a clear execution plan from startup through closeout.
* Coordinate priorities and management resources across all projects.

**Scheduling and Progress Control**

* Make sure every project has a detailed baseline schedule, updated at least weekly.
* Compare planned progress against actual site progress; review critical-path activities, trade dependencies and long-lead items.
* Confirm materials, subcontractors, inspections and client decisions are aligned with the schedule.
* Identify preventable delays and require recovery schedules when projects fall behind; make sure completion dates are realistic.
* Make sure PMs maintain procurement schedules and that sites are ready to receive and install materials.
* Maintain a company-level project schedule dashboard.

**Policies, Systems and Standard Operating Procedures**

* Develop, implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the entire construction division.
* Implement standardized checklists for project startup, scheduling, procurement, change orders, payment requests, compliance, documentation and closeout.
* Train team members on company procedures, audit whether they are being followed, and take corrective action when they are not.
* Be the company's Procore expert and enforce it: make sure everyone follows protocol in Procore for daily logs, photos, RFIs, submittals, change orders and current drawings.
* Set standard folder structures and naming, and conduct regular project-file audits.
* Keep every project file organized, complete and current, and prevent critical information from remaining only in verbal conversations, texts or personal emails.

**Site Standards, Quality and Safety**

* Conduct routine site audits of every PM's projects for safety, quality, cleanliness and progress; issue written actions and follow up until closed.
* Establish and enforce quality-control procedures; require PMs to inspect and document work before it is covered.
* Make sure construction follows approved drawings, specifications and authorized changes, and that consultant reviews and inspections are coordinated.
* Track permits, inspection results, deficiencies, occupancy requirements and permit closeout; prevent work from proceeding where required approvals are missing.
* Oversee safety administration: site safety documentation, toolbox talks, incident reporting and corrective actions. This role does not replace any legally required constructor, competent supervisor or health and safety representative.

**Project Startup and Closeout**

* Run formal project startup meetings so each PM receives and understands the contract, drawings, permits, budget, schedule, trade scopes and procurement plan.
* Make sure information is properly transferred from Estimating to Construction and Accounting.
* Make sure PMs complete formal closeout: final inspections, occupancy, deficiencies, warranties, manuals, final invoices, holdbacks and client sign-offs.
* Conduct lessons-learned reviews and make sure project records are archived.

**Client and Issue Management**

* Make sure PMs communicate with clients consistently and professionally, and do not make unauthorized promises on cost or schedule.
* Monitor unresolved client concerns, selections and decisions; make sure important decisions and meeting minutes are documented.
* Step into difficult client, consultant or subcontractor situations before they escalate.

**Reporting to Ownership**

* Prepare a clear weekly portfolio report: projects behind schedule, projects at risk of exceeding budget, client and subcontractor issues, missing compliance documents, quality and safety concerns, and decisions required from Ownership.
* Implement a consistent weekly project-reporting format; review and challenge PM reports before issues reach Ownership.
* Flag staffing and resource problems and operational matters affecting cash flow.
* Lead a monthly margin review by project with the Financial Controller.
* Make sure management decisions are implemented.

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* Minimum eight years of progressive residential construction experience with a builder, general contractor or major renovation contractor.
* Experience as a Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager, Operations Manager, Senior Site Superintendent or comparable construction leader.
* Demonstrated experience supervising Project Managers or Site Supervisors, and overseeing multiple active projects at once.
* Hands-on experience defining trade scopes, buying out projects and signing subcontracts.
* Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction through closeout and warranty.

**Required Construction Knowledge**

* Residential construction sequencing and trade coordination, from excavation, underpinning and foundations through framing, MEP, building envelope and interior finishes.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, mechanical and electrical drawings and identify missing scope.
* Project budgets, committed costs, cost-to-complete forecasting, change orders, progress invoicing and holdbacks.
* Ontario Building Code, permits and inspections; Form 1000, WSIB clearances and certificates of insurance.

**Leadership Skills**

* Leadership presence and the ability to earn the respect of experienced construction professionals.
* Comfortable challenging unrealistic schedules, incomplete information and weak explanations.
* Able to hold people accountable professionally and consistently.
* Calm and effective with urgent matters, client concerns and subcontractor disputes.
* Strong judgment, organization and follow-up; takes ownership of problems through to resolution.
* Communicates clearly with Ownership, clients, consultants, subcontractors and employees.

**Technology**

* Procore certification is required within your first 60 days. You will become our expert user, because you will enforce Procore across the team.
* Strong with technology in general and quick to learn new software.
* Construction scheduling software (Microsoft Project or comparable); strong Microsoft Excel.
* Experience creating project dashboards and management reports, and reviewing job-costing reports.

**Education and Credentials**

* Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Construction Engineering Technology, Civil Engineering, Architectural Technology or Building Science; or a Red Seal or Certificate of Qualification in a construction trade (such as carpentry) combined with progressive supervisory experience. Equivalent senior-level residential construction experience will also be considered.
* Gold Seal Certification (Project Manager or Superintendent), PMP, P.Eng. or C.E.T. is preferred.
* Ontario Building Code training or BCIN qualification (House or Small Buildings) is an asset.
* Working knowledge of the Ontario Construction Act (holdbacks, liens and prompt payment) and of Tarion and HCRA requirements.
* Current site safety training: Supervisor Health and Safety Awareness, Working at Heights, WHMIS and Standard First Aid, or willingness to complete them before starting.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Ontario G driver's licence. A company vehicle is available at the office for site visits.
* Ability to travel regularly between our Richmond Hill office and project sites across the GTA.
* Willingness to occasionally address urgent project matters outside regular business hours.
* Legally entitled to work in Canada.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You can:

* Write a trade scope that leaves no gaps and no room for extras.
* Recognize when a PM's schedule is unrealistic.
* Identify when materials should already have been ordered.
* Determine whether a delay was unavoidable or caused by poor planning.
* Challenge unsupported subcontractor invoices and extras.
* Recognize missing trade scope and coordination problems.
* Help develop practical recovery plans.
* Step into difficult client or subcontractor situations.
* Identify when projects are quietly moving off schedule, over budget or outside company procedures.

We are a very fast-paced company and we are growing quickly. You are driven, punctual and reliable. You multitask well, stay calm and productive under pressure, and are comfortable when priorities change. You are strong with technology. You want to join a winning team and help take the company to the next level.

You are organized, direct, fair and consistent. High-rise only, civil, industrial or coordinator-level backgrounds are not a fit for this role.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first six to twelve months, you will:

* Have every trade on every project properly scoped and under contract, with compliance documents on file.
* Have every active project on an accurate, current schedule and tracking to its budget.
* Establish consistent accountability across all Project Managers.
* Provide Ownership with reliable weekly project-health reporting.
* Put standardized startup, reporting, change-order and closeout procedures in place.
* Reduce missing documentation, unsupported payments and unauthorized extras.
* Improve communication between PMs, Accounting and Ownership, and improve PM performance and follow-through.
* Build scalable systems that support Plexcon's continued growth.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary of $120,000 a year, plus performance bonuses tied to projects finishing on budget and on schedule. Expected total pay: $120,000 to $150,000 a year.
* Company vehicle available at the office for site visits.
* The senior construction role in a growing builder, working directly with Ownership.
* Real authority over trades, budgets and how projects are run.
* The chance to build the systems and develop the team of Project Managers.
* Room to grow with the company as its portfolio and management team expand.

**To Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short note covering: how many Project Managers or projects you have overseen at once, the type of builder you worked for, and one process you put in place that improved how projects were delivered.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Hiring notices**

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use artificial intelligence tools to help screen applications; a person makes every hiring decision.

We do not require Canadian work experience. Equivalent experience from any country is welcome.

Plexcon Construction Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodation is available on request at every stage of the hiring process, in line with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the AODA.

Applicants who are interviewed will be told the outcome within 45 days of their last interview.

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Have you directly supervised Project Managers or site supervisors? How many, and at which company?
* Have you personally negotiated and signed subcontracts with trades? Briefly describe your role.
* How many active construction projects have you overseen at one time?
* Are you Procore certified? If yes, which certifications do you hold?

Experience:

* residential construction: 8 years (preferred)

* Class G Licence (required)

Title: Food Operations Manager
Description:
**About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

As the Food Operations Manager, you'll be the face of Foodsmart's food operations to our health plan and payer clients, and the person who makes sure members get the right food, on time. You'll report to the Senior Director of Client Operations and help lead the team that runs our food benefit programs end to end.

Foodsmart’s food benefit programs connect clinical nutrition care to real food getting to members’ homes. That means working closely with health plan clients, food vendors, and our clinical teams, with data moving between all of them. You’ll own how that work runs day to day, make sure it works for members and clients, and dig into why when it doesn’t. This role suits someone who is confident with clients, rigorous about root causes, great at organizing complex processes, and comfortable with ambiguity in a growing, evolving program.

### **You will:**

* Design and own the workflows that run food operations, both internally and together with clients: define how food is assessed, approved, and shipped, explain why each step exists and what data we need from the client and what we provide, and secure client buy-in
* Bring internal teams together to follow those workflows consistently, and organize and standardize processes and SOPs across the food operations team
* Oversee the flow from clinician assessment through payer approval to vendor fulfillment, and make sure every handoff works
* Coordinate with our multiple food vendors and operationalize processes across all of them, holding them to service and quality standards
* Lead vendor change management: when something changes, such as a file design, get buy-in from every vendor, explain what is happening, and coordinate timing with them before implementing
* Partner with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot and implement our new food benefit management (FBM) system, including testing, rollout, and team training
* Manage data exchanges with clients and vendors, including SFTP file transfers and file design, and resolve data quality issues
* Serve as a client-facing lead for food operations, speaking with payer and health plan clients about incidents, program performance, and escalations with confidence and clarity
* Manage and resolve escalations from clients, vendors, and internal teams, and keep everyone updated until each one is closed
* Run root cause analysis when food doesn't ship correctly, and drive the fixes that keep it from happening again

Title: Senior Manager Logistics
Description:
JOB PURPOSE
  
Responsible for the end-to-end management, operation, and optimization of inbound and outbound logistics for VinFast Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Spare Parts/Accessories across Canada. Ensures all shipments, customs clearances, warehouse operations, and showroom/workshops deliveries are executed safely, accurately, and on schedule at optimal cost, while fully complying with Canadian border regulations (CBSA), CARM frameworks, tax mandates (GST/HST/PST), and corporate quality standards.
  
  
II. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
1. Vehicle Logistics & VDC Operations
  

* Vehicle Import & Distribution:
* Plan and coordinate inbound vehicle shipping from ocean ports/rail terminals to Vehicle Distribution Centers (VDCs) and compounds across Ontario, Quebec, and British Columbia.
* Manage local car-hauler carrier networks and rail transport logistics, ensuring fleet capacity for regional deliveries to VinFast Stores, Service Centers.
* VDC Operations:
* Oversee yard management, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) workflows, detail/wash bays, firmware/OTA software updates, and high voltage and Low Voltage battery charging/maintenance protocols for EV stock.
* Maintain exact real-time inventory records by Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) across SAP ERP and WMS platforms.
* Transit Damage & Claims:
* Coordinate surveys, insurance claims, and transit damage repairs with carriers, 3PL compound operators, and local certified bodyshops.

2. Spare Parts Logistics
  

* Parts Warehouse Operations:
* Direct daily Parts Distribution Center (PDC) operations (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and dispatch), ensuring high Order Fulfillment and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for Canadian Service Centers and collision networks.
* Optimize PDC layout, slotting strategies, picking routes, and HAZMAT handling for EV Lithium-ion battery and other Hazmat parts.
* Inventory Control & Planning:
* Partner with Spare Part department to maintain safety stock levels while mitigating slow moving and obsolete inventory.
* Lead routine cycle counts and annual physical inventory audits, ensuring minimum SAP inventory accuracy of 99.5%.

**Parts Outbound Fulfillment & Service Network Distribution:**  

* Oversee end-to-end outbound logistics and distribution operations for spare parts and accessories from the PDC to VinFast Service Centers, body shops, and authorized 3rd party workshops.
* Manage multi-modal freight transport strategies, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), and dedicated local shuttle routes for routine stock replenishment.
* Direct express delivery services (e.g., FedEx, local couriers) for time-critical and emergency Vehicle Off Road (VOR) parts orders, ensuring strict adherence to repair SLA deadlines.

3. Canadian Customs & Trade Compliance
  

* CBSA & CARM Compliance:
* Oversee Canadian customs compliance, eManifest filings, and import documentation via the CBSA Assessment and Revenue Management (CARM) Client Portal.
* Partner directly with licensed Customs Brokers to ensure accurate HS Code classifications, valuation declarations, and intercompany related-party transfer pricing compliance.
* Tax & Import Regulatory Filings:
* Manage GST/HST and PST tax accounting for imported vehicles and parts in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure compliance with Transport Canada regulations, CMVSS safety standards, and customs liquidation requirements.

4. Vendor Management (3PL) & Cost Optimization
  

* Manage Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers, including port compound operators, car haulers, warehousing contractors, and customs brokers.
* Monitor vendor performance against monthly KPI/SLA metrics (On-Time Delivery, Damage-Free Rate, Order Accuracy).
* Prepare logistics operational budgets, track freight costs, control demurrage/detention charges, and implement cost-reduction initiatives.

5. Systems & Reporting
  

* Utilize SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM), WMS/TMS platforms, and Power BI dashboards to track delivery milestones, inventory aging, and logistics performance.
* Generate regular management reports on On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, stock aging, and logistics cost-per-unit metrics.

III. JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
1. Education & Experience
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, or a related field.
* Experience:
* Minimum 5–7 years of logistics and supply chain experience, with at least 3 years in a management/lead role within the Automotive Industry in Canada.
* Hands-on experience managing both Finished Vehicles (VDC/Car Haulers) and Spare Parts Warehousing (PDC).

2. Technical & Core Competencies
  

* Customs & Compliance: In-depth knowledge of Canadian customs processes, CBSA regulations, CARM portal, eManifest, Incoterms (FOB, CIF, EXW), and GST/HST tax rules.
* ERP & Systems: Proficient in SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM modules), WMS/TMS software, and data tools (Excel / Power BI).
* Vendor & Contract Management: Strong negotiation skills with 3PLs, freight carriers, and warehouse contractors.
* Languages: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Professional working proficiency in French is a strong asset for Quebec market operations.

3. Key Attributes
  

* Strong analytical mindset, highly organized, and thriving in a fast-paced EV growth environment.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills (interacting with Sales, Aftersales Service, Finance, and Legal).
* Flexibility to travel to regional VDCs, PDCs, ocean ports, and retail locations across Canada as needed.

Title: BOLD & GOLD Logistics Manager
Description:
Overview:

**Our Commitment to Equity**

The Y actively promotes a culture free from bias and injustice. We are dedicated to removing institutional and systemic barriers that result in oppression and racism. We will be accountable to marginalized communities for creating equitable and sustainable environments where social justice is woven into every facet of our programs, and by caring for our communities in a culturally versatile and respectful manner.

**Compensation:** $185.00/day

**Tell Me About This Job!**

The Logistics Manager is responsible for assisting in the management of the systems that support our wilderness-based expeditions. The Logistics Manager works closely with the Operations Manager and other members of the seasonal Leadership Team to ensure that instructors and participants are provided with the necessary resources to be successful and comfortable while on trip. Responsibilities include supervising logistics staff, overseeing food systems, and managing equipment for the BOLD & GOLD summer season.

BOLD & GOLD is dedicated to inspiring courage and confidence in diverse groups of youth through outdoor adventures. As a program of the Camping & Outdoor Leadership branch of the YMCA of Greater Seattle, BOLD & GOLD offers year-round partnership programs and summer expedition experiences. Partnership programs engage with schools, non-profits, and community-based organizations to design and implement transformative outdoor experiences. The summer expedition program runs single-gender and all-gender expeditions that engage youth through front country and backcountry trips ranging in length from 5 to 15 days. BOLD & GOLD experiences take place in Mt Rainier National Park, North Cascades National Park, Olympic National Park, National Forests, Washington State Parks, and local green spaces. Activities include backpacking, rock climbing, kayaking, snowshoeing, fishing, art, and teambuilding. The goal of BOLD & GOLD is to increase confidence, courage, emotional intelligence, wonder, and community awareness in our participants. BOLD & GOLD believes these traits are the foundations of leadership and works to inspire participants to develop their own leadership style. BOLD & GOLD prepares young people to be the next generation of leaders through multicultural experiential education in the natural world.

Find out more at www.ymcaleadership.org.

**What You'll Get From Working at the Y**

* Individual membership to the YMCA of Greater Seattle.
* Free access to mental health resources.
* Rapidly accruing paid time off (PTO)
* Subsidized ORCA Transit Pass.
* Access to discounted gear and equipment through pro deals.

  
Responsibilities:

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Ensure safety, quality, and organization of all logistical systems for wilderness courses.
* Manage the organization, function, and availability of all program equipment, including backpacking, camping, rock climbing and mountaineering technical equipment, clothing, etc.
* Plan, purchase, and organize field appropriate and culturally appropriate meals.
* Work within a leadership team to ensure all staff and participants have the equipment, tools and knowledge needed to be successful.
* Manage a team of 3-6 Logistics Staff Members who will aid in the delivery of the summer program.
* Collaborate with staff to pack and prepare all field-going food and equipment.
* Manage dietary needs for participants and staff ensuring individuals have equitable and appropriate options for allergies and dietary preferences.
* Model cultural humility and celebrate diversity, effectively working with people of different identities, backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
* Ensure both a physically and an emotionally safe and inclusive environment for youth and staff.
* Other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Environment**

BOLD & GOLD is based out of the Cascade People’s Center (CPC), located in Seattle, WA. BOLD & GOLD courses begin and end at the CPC. BOLD & GOLD programming takes place in remote wilderness locations (national park, national forest, state park land) across Washington State. The Logistics Manager role is primarily office based, aside from participation in staff training, driving, and other field-based support.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Employees must be able to lift and carry items weighing up to 50lbs, safely travel over varied terrain (trails, tree roots, boulder/rock fields, shoreline, mud, snow, ice) up to 15 miles per day, be comfortable spending multiple days and/or weeks in a wilderness setting, communicate both verbally and non-verbally with other staff, volunteers, and participants. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work**

This is a seasonal exempt position, and staff are paid a daily rate. Logistic Mangers will work approximately 40-50 hours per week on a Thursday-Monday schedule. The approximate schedule will be from late-May - early September. This includes Leadership Team training, Logistics Team training, and All Staff Training which occurs in June.

**Travel**

BOLD & GOLD employees must be able to commute to the Cascade People’s Center, 309 Pontius Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109. Parking is not available onsite, but there is paid public parking located around the building. The area is serviced by several public bus routes. All travel required for work will be done in YMCA vehicles. This is an Authorized Driver position, read more in the Position Requirements.

Code of Conduct for Applicants

**All employees and volunteers are responsible for adhering to abuse prevention policies, maintaining appropriate boundaries, completing required training, reporting suspicious or inappropriate behavior, and complying with mandated reporting requirements.**

**Responsible for ensuring staff are properly screened, trained, supervised and held accountable to the organization’s abuse risk management standards.**

Qualifications:

**Position Requirements**

* Experience managing wilderness trip logistics including food, equipment, and first aid supplies.
* Experience working with outdoor equipment, including repair and maintenance.
* Experience planning and packing backcountry food for parties of ten or more.
* Ability to manage a strong cohesive team and create an inclusive environment for staff and youth.
* Ability to role model compassionate and confident leadership.
* High level of self-awareness and can work in a collaborative setting.
* Commitment to working with diverse groups of youth and staff.
* Possesses strong organizational skills, flexibility, and a problem-solving mentality.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Office suit (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Other applicable education, training, and experience, which provide the knowledge, abilities, and skills necessary to perform effectively in the position will be considered.
* Current WFA and CPR Certification\*
* Current Washington State Food Handlers Permit\*
* Leave No Trace 101 Certification\*
* Required by start date

**This Position Requires Driving:**

BOLD & GOLD uses 14-passenger minibuses to transport passengers and equipment to trailheads and campsites, including driving on interstates, city streets, and rural roads.

**Driving Duties Requirement**

This role transports clients as an “authorized driver” for the YMCA of Greater Seattle (YGS) using an employer-provided vehicle. **Driving duties for this role are Required.** Driving roles are safety-sensitive. To become an authorized driver, you must be 21+, have possessed a driver's license for at least 3 years, and pass a drug screen that will test for impairing substances (including marijuana) in addition to meeting the driving record standards below:

**Within the last five (5) years:** No Major Violations which include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Driving with an open container of alcohol
* Reckless Driving
* Hit and Run – property damage only (Incidents resulting in injury fall under Permanent Disqualification)
* Racing
* Driving with a suspended/revoked license/insurance
* Speeding over 20 mph
* Fleeing and/or eluding police
* Any other felony driving conviction(s)

**Driving records that result in permanent disqualification from driving duties:**

* More than 3 DUI, DWI, OUI, OWI, BUI, Administrative Per Se, or Refusing to Test for entirety of driving history.
* More than 3 Driving with a suspended/revoked license
* Hit and Run resulting in bodily injury or death
* Manslaughter/felony death by motor vehicle

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Current WFR or W-EMT
* Prefer knowledge of and previous experience with diverse populations (language, culture, race, physical ability, sexual orientation, etc.). Ability to speak any language in addition to English may be helpful.
* Experience with anti-racism practices.

Other combinations of applicable education, training, and experience which provide the knowledge, abilities, and skills necessary to perform effectively in the position may be considered.

**Our Mission**

Building a community where all people, especially the young, are encouraged to develop their fullest potential in spirit, mind, and body.
  
  
**Our Values**

* Respect
* Responsibility
* Honesty
* Caring
* Passion for Excellence

YGS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and equitable work environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by local, state, or federal law.
  
  
All job offers are contingent on the results of a background check. We participate in the Federal E-Verify system.

Title: Group Procurement Director

Title: Senior Manager – Financial and Property Management Consultancy Services
Description:
Job Title: Senior Manager – Financial and Property Management Consultancy Services
  
  
Reports to: Head of Financial and Property Management Consultancy
  
  
Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA)
  
  
Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager specializing in Real Estate Consultancy Services to strengthen our financial and property management consultancy team. The candidate will possess strong expertise in developing complex development, master community, and building operating and service charge models, service charge apportionment methodologies, life cycle costing and reserve fund modeling, break-even point analysis, and operating expense analysis. In addition to project management and client reporting, this role requires exceptional presentation skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to support the line manager in developing and advising innovative and market-leading consultancy solutions. The preferred candidate for this role would ideally be located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) or demonstrate a willingness to relocate.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  
Project Execution
  
  

* Lead the development and technical review of complex development, master community and building service charge models in line with applicable RICS guidance and local regulatory requirements, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in calculating service charges for diverse real estate developments and properties. Hold sign-off accountability for model accuracy before issue to the client.
* Define and defend service charge apportionment methodologies as per the best market practices, and advise on void cost treatment, phased occupancy and cross-subsidy between asset classes.
* Conduct break-even point (BEP) analysis to evaluate the financial feasibility and profitability of real estate projects, including occupancy thresholds and service charge recovery, and present the implications to clients for investment and operating decisions.
* client financial reporting requirements, including the preparation of financial statements, budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, and service charge reconciliations, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of reports. Support audit and owner or tenant queries.
* Develop and implement comprehensive financial policies and procedures that encompass the operational finance aspect of the client's portfolio, including delegation of authority, procurement and approval controls, and budget governance. These policies and procedures will enhance financial controls, streamline processes, and ensure strict adherence to industry standards and regulations.
* Lead the delivery of interactive dashboards and reports for C-suite executives, presenting key financial metrics, performance analysis, key cost and revenue drivers and strategic recommendations. Ensure dashboard data reconciles to the underlying models.
* Communicate and defend complex financial concepts, including service charge apportionment, service charge recovery, and the implications of void costs, to clients, colleagues, and stakeholders. Act as the technical escalation point for the team and clients on methodology.
* Conduct in-depth analysis of real estate operating expenses, comparing trends, and benchmarking results against industry standards across the GCC region. Build and maintain GCC benchmarking datasets as a reusable firm asset and use them to challenge client cost assumptions and facilities management pricing.
* Lead engagement with external parties (e.g., facilities management providers) to review, assess, and update the service rate cards periodically, to reflect market trends, changes in service scope, or any new services introduced by the facilities management companies. Review facilities management service scope, SLAs and contract costs, including tender evaluation support.
* Interpret development master plans and designs, encompassing architectural and engineering drawings, for the purpose of establishing services to estimate operating expenses and develop these into service charge regimes. Provide operability and cost input at design stage and define the asset and systems inventory that supports operating cost and life cycle assumptions.
* Develop, analyze, and evaluate property and asset management operating models and their associated impact on the service charge, including delivery and procurement options and their effect on owner returns.
* Lead the development and oversight of life cycle costing models for buildings, infrastructure and master community assets, covering asset registers, component service lives, renewal cycles, cost escalation and discount assumptions, using recognized standards such as ISO 15686-5 where applicable.
* Lead reserve fund assessments and models that determine required contribution levels, funding adequacy and the phasing of major capital replacement over the long term, and test funding strategies through scenario and sensitivity analysis.
* Integrate life cycle costing and reserve fund outputs into annual budgets, long-term forecasts and funding recommendations to owners and associations.
* Review condition surveys and asset data inputs, and take accountability for the quality of the assumptions behind long-term projections.
* Set modeling standards, version control, assumptions registers and independent review requirements, ensuring every model is reviewed by someone other than its builder before release.
* Capture reusable methods, templates and lessons learned into firm tools, and drive automation of recurring models using Excel, Power BI and Python.

Project Management
  
  

* Effectively lead and manage consultancy mandates simultaneously, ensuring seamless project management and execution of deliverables within timelines.
* Lead the interpretation and evaluation of Request for Proposals, requirements and Request for Quotations issued by clients and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams to develop technical and commercial proposals.
* Ensure timely delivery of project deliverables and compliance with client requirements.
* Continuously monitor project progress against risk, timelines and deliverables, adjusting plans and resources to execute.
* Own scope and change control, and track fees and resource utilization across mandates.
* Spend time at client offices and project sites for in-person meetings and to support project requirements as needed.

Client Management and Business Development
  
  

* Travel across the GCC region to attend client meetings, presentations, and industry events to build and strengthen client relationships and explore new business opportunities.
* Build and foster strong client relationships to establish trust and understanding to provide tailored operational financial solutions.
* Identify business development opportunities and contribute to the growth of the Financial and Property Management consultancy business, including developing leads, pitching services, and participating in the preparation and submission of new business proposals.

Strategic Thinking
  
  

* Employ a strategic mindset to identify real estate opportunities for process improvement, cost optimization, and revenue generation for our clients.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand the development and operational stages of the real estate industry and integrate financial analysis into strategic decision-making.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and regulatory changes to provide valuable insights and make informed recommendations.
* Support the line manager in the development of new consultancy products and services, through market research, competitive analysis, and client insights.

Team Management

client financial reporting requirements, including the preparation of financial statements, budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, and service charge reconciliations, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of reports. Support audit and owner or tenant queries.

Description:
**Restaurant Shift Lead / Supervisor**

**JOB DESCRIPTION | RESTAURANT & CATERING OPERATIONS**

Location: New York City, NY  
Reports to: Restaurant management  
Supervises: Restaurant team members on assigned shifts

**Position summary**
--------------------

Lead assigned shifts at Doner Thyme, an Istanbul street-food fast-casual restaurant. Provide hands-on support across all five stations and ensure safe, efficient and consistent dine-in, takeaway, delivery and catering service. Follow approved procedures and escalate staffing, purchasing, financial and policy decisions to management.

**1. Daily restaurant operations**
----------------------------------

* Execute assigned opening and closing duties and maintain service readiness throughout the shift; coordinate team members according to the approved schedule.
* Conduct opening inspections, verify equipment and product readiness, confirm certified food protection coverage and lead the pre-shift huddle.
* Assign station owners, coordinate breaks and shift coverage, and redeploy staff according to demand without compromising safety or service.
* Monitor order queues, product availability, ticket times and guest wait times; resolve bottlenecks and maintain communication between stations.
* Coordinate dine-in, takeaway, online and delivery orders; ensure all channels are accurately processed and fulfilled.
* Verify closing checklists, food disposition, storage, cleaning, cash reconciliation and site security; communicate outstanding issues to the next shift.

**2. Leadership across all five stations**
------------------------------------------

* Cashier & Front of House: oversee hospitality, Toast POS accuracy, allergen communication, upselling and guest-area readiness.
* Doner Slicing and Pita Baking: verify product quality, production readiness, replenishment and authorized equipment use.
* Fry & Assembly and Packing & Catering: verify portion control, recipe compliance, order accuracy, packaging and handoff.

**Service, catering & team supervision**
========================================

**3. Catering and large-order operations**
------------------------------------------

* Handle routine catering inquiries and order confirmations using approved procedures; refer pricing exceptions and special requests to management.
* Review upcoming catering commitments daily, including quantities, dietary restrictions, pickup or delivery windows and payment status.
* Coordinate shift-level preparation, station assignments and packaging supplies with the central prep kitchen and restaurant team.
* Follow approved catering production plans and adjust shift tasks to meet deadlines without disrupting regular service.
* Verify every catering order against its ticket, including portions, labels, allergen instructions, accompaniments and requested service supplies.
* Coordinate delivery or pickup logistics, verify handoff and communicate delays promptly; resolve missing or incorrect items and record customer feedback.
* Record catering order completion, cancellations and service issues; report customer feedback to management.

**4. Employee supervision, training and development**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Assist with onboarding and practical station training; reinforce attendance, uniform and conduct standards.
* Follow approved schedules, verify attendance and required breaks, and report coverage needs and timekeeping discrepancies to management.
* Support cross-training across all five stations within the first 30 days and document station readiness for management approval.
* Update training records, report certification deadlines and verify staff authorization for assigned duties.
* Coach employees through demonstrations and constructive feedback; recognize strong performance and report concerns.
* Promote respectful teamwork, address routine conflicts and refer formal disciplinary and employment decisions to management.

**5. Guest experience and brand standards**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain welcoming, professional service and consistent product presentation; conduct shift leader product tastings and quality checks.
* Resolve guest complaints, remakes and refunds within authorized limits; document serious complaints and escalate allergen or safety incidents immediately.
* Monitor guest feedback and order accuracy; identify recurring issues and implement approved corrective actions.

**Food safety, facilities & inventory**
=======================================

**6. Food safety and regulatory compliance**
--------------------------------------------

* Maintain valid NYC Food Protection certification and ensure certified supervisory coverage whenever required during operations.
* Verify food receiving, storage, labeling, rotation, cooking, holding and temperature records against the approved operational manual and NYC requirements.
* Monitor handwashing, glove use, illness reporting, hair restraints, sanitation and allergen cross-contact controls; verify POS allergen alerts through final handoff.
* Stop service of unsafe products or equipment, document corrective actions and notify senior management; ensure safe release before resuming service.
* Keep shift records inspection-ready, cooperate with health department inspections and report deficiencies to management.

**7. Cleaning, equipment and workplace safety**
-----------------------------------------------

* Assign and verify daily cleaning of all three doner machines, all three cutting robots, fryer, pita oven, bain-marie, refrigeration and food-contact surfaces.
* Ensure continuous cleaning of the front of house, mezzanine dining area, tables, chairs, windows, floors, drains, waste areas and storage.
* Verify completion of scheduled cleaning and oil-change tasks by authorized staff; report overdue professional hood service to management.
* Complete shift inspections, verify sanitizer checks and cleaning sign-offs, and report pest control, maintenance and repair needs to management.
* Ensure equipment is used only by trained, legally eligible and authorized staff; remove defective equipment from service and report injuries, hazards and emergencies.

**8. Inventory, replenishment and waste control**
-------------------------------------------------

* Monitor stock levels for regular service and catering; request replenishment from the central kitchen and report purchasing needs to management.
* Verify deliveries for quantity, quality, condition and required temperatures; document discrepancies and reject or isolate unsuitable products.
* Maintain accurate inventory counts, proper stock rotation and storage organization; prevent shortages, excess production and unauthorized use.
* Record waste, monitor portion compliance and product yields, and report variances to management.

**Shift controls & candidate requirements**
===========================================

**9. Cash handling and shift reporting**
----------------------------------------

* Oversee Toast POS transactions, cash drawers, refunds, discounts, voids and complimentary items within authorized limits.
* Complete end-of-shift sales and payment reconciliation, secure cash according to company procedures and report discrepancies.
* Record shift sales, catering completion, attendance and waste using approved reporting procedures; flag significant variances.
* Maintain accurate operational records, incident reports, shift notes, training records and maintenance logs; protect confidential employee and customer information.
* Submit shift reports covering service speed, order accuracy, waste, guest feedback and outstanding issues.
* Suggest operational improvements to management. Hiring, termination, formal discipline, scheduling approval, payroll, purchasing, budgets and policy changes remain management responsibilities.

**10. Candidate qualifications**
--------------------------------

* Previous experience in a food service establishment is strongly preferred; prior shift lead, team lead or supervisory experience is preferred.
* Valid NYC Food Protection Certificate required before independently supervising food operations. An equivalent basic food handler card does not replace this certificate.
* Demonstrated leadership, organization, communication, problem-solving and customer-service skills; ability to coach a diverse team in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to learn Toast POS and shift reporting procedures and become proficient across all five operational stations.
* Availability for assigned opening, closing, weekend, holiday and catering shifts according to business needs and applicable scheduling requirements.
* Ability to perform essential job functions, including standing, moving through the restaurant and supporting service, including safely lifting and carrying items weighing up to 40 pounds (18 kg), with or without reasonable accommodation.

**11. Performance expectations**
--------------------------------

Success is measured by safe and timely shift execution, inspection readiness, catering fulfillment, guest satisfaction, order accuracy, team training, stock and waste control, and reliable opening and closing. Food safety and employee safety take priority over speed and cost targets.

This description summarizes the essential responsibilities of the role. Additional related duties may be assigned within the employee’s training, authority and applicable law.
