Description:
**Company Description**

**About Basiqat by Mantis**

Basiqat by Mantis is an upcoming luxury eco-resort in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operating under Mantis, part of the Accor Group.

Currently in its pre-opening phase, Basiqat by Mantis is preparing to introduce a distinctive hospitality experience that combines luxury, nature, sustainability, and authentic local culture.

As part of the global Accor family, we are committed to creating exceptional guest experiences while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and inspiring workplace for our Heartists.

We are seeking passionate and dedicated professionals to join our pre-opening team and contribute to the successful launch of this unique destination.

 **Job Description**

**Pastry Chef**

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia  
**Department:** Culinary  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Position Level:** Chef de Cuisine  
**Reporting To:** Executive Sous Chef

**Job Summary**

Basiqat by Mantis is seeking a highly experienced, creative, and passionate Pastry Chef at Chef de Cuisine level to join our pre-opening culinary leadership team.

The successful candidate will assume full operational and managerial responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations, ensuring exceptional product quality, culinary creativity, operational efficiency, and consistency across all Food & Beverage outlets.

The Pastry Chef will lead the development of distinctive pastry, bakery, dessert, and confectionery concepts that reflect the resort's luxury positioning, local cultural influences, and commitment to sustainable hospitality.

Operating at Chef de Cuisine level, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing the entire pastry and bakery team, developing menus, overseeing production, managing departmental costs, maintaining food safety standards, and driving continuous culinary innovation.

As a key member of the pre-opening team, the Pastry Chef will play an instrumental role in establishing the pastry and bakery kitchens, developing signature offerings, selecting equipment, implementing operational procedures, and building a high-performing culinary team from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pastry & Bakery Operations Management**

* Assume full leadership and operational responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations.
* Oversee daily production, preparation, presentation, and distribution of pastry and bakery products across all Food & Beverage outlets.
* Ensure consistent quality, taste, presentation, freshness, and portion control in accordance with luxury hospitality standards.
* Manage the production of desserts, artisan breads, viennoiseries, cakes, chocolates, confectionery, and other specialty pastry products.
* Establish production schedules based on occupancy forecasts, outlet requirements, guest preferences, and special events.
* Ensure efficient coordination between pastry, bakery, culinary, restaurant, lounge, and in-room dining operations.
* Maintain exceptional standards of organization, cleanliness, and operational discipline within the pastry and bakery kitchens.
* Monitor production efficiency and ensure timely delivery of products to all relevant outlets.
* Maintain a strong operational presence and provide hands-on leadership during critical production and service periods.

**Menu Development & Culinary Innovation**

* Lead the development and implementation of innovative pastry, bakery, and dessert menus aligned with the resort's culinary vision.
* Create distinctive signature desserts and pastry experiences that reflect the luxury positioning of Basiqat by Mantis.
* Develop seasonal menus incorporating locally sourced ingredients, regional flavors, and contemporary culinary techniques.
* Design premium pastry offerings for restaurant, lounge, in-room dining, afternoon tea, and special guest experiences, as applicable.
* Develop customized cakes, desserts, and confectionery for VIP guests, celebrations, and special occasions.
* Incorporate authentic Saudi Arabian culinary influences into contemporary pastry creations where appropriate.
* Develop suitable offerings for guests with dietary requirements, including gluten-free, vegan, dairy-free, and reduced-sugar alternatives.
* Conduct regular product tastings, recipe evaluations, and menu development sessions.
* Establish standardized recipes, production methods, presentation guidelines, and portion specifications.
* Monitor international pastry trends and introduce innovative techniques and products that enhance the resort's culinary reputation.
* Collaborate with Culinary and Food & Beverage leadership on menu engineering, promotional activities, and signature dining experiences.

**Pre-Opening Pastry & Bakery Readiness**

* Lead the establishment and operational setup of the pastry and bakery kitchens during the resort's pre-opening phase.
* Develop and implement departmental standard operating procedures, production workflows, recipe manuals, and operational checklists.
* Review pastry and bakery kitchen layouts, equipment specifications, storage facilities, and production arrangements.
* Coordinate with Culinary, Purchasing, Engineering, and relevant departments on equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and operational testing.
* Support the identification and procurement of furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), and operating supplies and equipment (OS&E) required for pastry and bakery operations.
* Establish ingredient specifications, supplier requirements, purchasing standards, and inventory controls.
* Develop opening menus, signature products, standardized recipes, and detailed recipe costing.
* Participate in supplier evaluations, ingredient sampling, equipment demonstrations, and product quality assessments.
* Support the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of pastry and bakery Heartists.
* Establish production schedules, staffing requirements, and operational workflows in accordance with the approved manpower plan.
* Conduct menu tastings, production trials, mock service sessions, and operational simulations before opening.
* Monitor pre-opening milestones, identify operational risks, and provide regular readiness updates to Culinary leadership.
* Ensure the pastry and bakery kitchens are fully operational and prepared for the resort's opening.

**Team Leadership & Culinary Development**

* Lead, supervise, motivate, and develop the entire pastry and bakery team.
* Establish clear performance expectations, production standards, and individual responsibilities.
* Prepare duty rosters and allocate manpower according to forecasted business volumes and operational requirements.
* Conduct daily briefings, production meetings, and regular coaching sessions.
* Provide hands-on training in advanced pastry techniques, bakery production, chocolate work, dessert presentation, and food safety.
* Develop training plans to enhance technical expertise, creativity, productivity, and consistency across the team.
* Identify high-potential Heartists and support succession planning and career development initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations, probation reviews, and individual development discussions.
* Monitor attendance, grooming, productivity, workplace conduct, and compliance with company standards.
* Promote teamwork, professionalism, creativity, inclusivity, and a positive culinary working environment.
* Coordinate with People & Culture and Learning & Development on departmental training and development requirements.

**Financial Performance, Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Manage pastry and bakery operational costs in accordance with approved departmental budgets.
* Participate in annual budgeting, forecasting, and culinary expenditure planning.
* Develop accurate recipe costing and ensure appropriate portion control across all pastry and bakery products.
* Monitor ingredient costs, production yields, inventory levels, wastage, and departmental operating expenses.
* Implement effective cost-control measures without compromising product quality or guest satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Finance and Purchasing on supplier selection, ingredient pricing, and purchasing efficiency.
* Monitor stock rotation, inventory accuracy, and appropriate storage conditions.
* Conduct regular inventory reviews and investigate discrepancies.
* Support menu engineering and product profitability analysis.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, reduce unnecessary expenditure, and maximize resource utilization.
* Monitor departmental productivity and optimize manpower deployment.
* Prepare regular reports on food costs, production performance, wastage, and departmental expenses.

**Luxury Guest Experience & Product Excellence**

* Ensure all pastry and bakery products reflect the highest standards of luxury hospitality and culinary excellence.
* Create memorable and personalized dessert experiences that enhance overall guest satisfaction.
* Coordinate customized pastry arrangements for VIP guests, special celebrations, and private dining experiences.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Guest Relations, and Food & Beverage teams to support personalized guest amenities and welcome experiences.
* Maintain exceptional standards of product presentation, creativity, consistency, and attention to detail.
* Monitor guest feedback and implement appropriate improvements to pastry and bakery offerings.
* Ensure dietary requirements, allergies, and special guest requests are handled accurately and safely.
* Support culinary events, promotional activities, and exclusive guest experiences that enhance the resort's reputation.

**Food Safety, Hygiene & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure all pastry and bakery operations comply with applicable food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and public health requirements.
* Implement and monitor HACCP principles and approved food safety procedures.
* Ensure proper handling, preparation, storage, labeling, and temperature control of ingredients and finished products.
* Establish effective allergen management and cross-contamination prevention procedures.
* Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, expiry dates, and stock rotation.
* Conduct regular inspections of pastry and bakery production areas, equipment, and storage facilities.
* Ensure compliance with approved cleaning schedules and sanitation procedures in coordination with Stewarding.
* Maintain accurate food safety, temperature monitoring, production, and hygiene records.
* Support internal audits, regulatory inspections, and quality assurance reviews.
* Implement corrective actions promptly and promote a strong culture of food safety and operational excellence.

**Sustainability & Responsible Culinary Practices**

* Support the resort's sustainability objectives through responsible pastry and bakery operations.
* Promote the use of locally sourced, seasonal, and responsibly produced ingredients where appropriate.
* Develop initiatives to reduce food waste, unnecessary packaging, water consumption, and energy usage.
* Implement efficient production planning to minimize overproduction and ingredient wastage.
* Collaborate with Purchasing and Culinary leadership to identify sustainable ingredient sourcing opportunities.
* Incorporate local ingredients and regional culinary traditions into innovative pastry and bakery creations.
* Encourage environmentally responsible practices among pastry and bakery Heartists.
* Ensure culinary operations reflect Mantis' commitment to responsible luxury hospitality.

**Administration, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

Title: Laboratory Supervisor - Full Time, Day Shift
Description:
Centered in the heart of Yuba-Sutter County, Adventist Health and Rideout has been one of the area's leading healthcare providers since 1907. We are comprised of a 221-bed hospital, 21 physician clinics, home care services, comprehensive cancer care and a vast scope of award-winning services located throughout Marysville and the surrounding areas. The allure of Marysville's community is complimented by its proximity to major metropolitan cities in the Bay Area and Sacramento, as well as just a quick drive to Lake Tahoe.

Job Summary:

Oversees the daily laboratory activity for all stat and routine laboratory testing and is able to perform the duties of a Clinical Laboratory Scientist. Is responsible for the personal and professional conduct of all personnel working in the laboratory and in the absence of the laboratory manager, coordinates standards for proficiency testing, Joint Commission and compliance with other regulatory agencies. Complies with operational budget, productivity, and acts as the Shift Supervisor. Supervises and directs the activities of various levels of assigned personnel using both professional and supervisory discretion and independent judgment.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Required
* Five years' clinical laboratory experience: Preferred
* Clinical Lab Scientist experience in hospital setting: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license in state of employment: Required in CA
* Current certification from American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or National Credentialing Agency for Labs (NCA): Preferred in CA and HI

Essential Functions:

* Employs positive patient identification procedures by all laboratory staff to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing. Performs proper specimen collection (including phlebotomy procedures as necessary), labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage. Rotates as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist working in various laboratory departments as a technologist as the need arises in the laboratory.
* Develops and documents laboratory support policies and procedures, including phlebotomy handbook. Investigates laboratory issues related to departments assigned, identifying root causes and proposing changes that will prevent similar incidents from occurring in the future. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
* Supervises technologists, phlebotomists, processors and laboratory support staff. Provides ongoing training and support and periodic performance evaluations. Manages staff scheduling and fills in for all positions as needed. Provides training, guidelines, and performance evaluations. Monitors department attendance and tardiness. Counsels individuals as necessary. Assures competency of all shift personnel.
* Maintains quality control and ensures compliance with rules, regulations and accreditation requirements of regulatory agencies, including Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), College of American Pathologists (CAP), Joint Commission (JC), AABB, and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA). Manages and maintains technical policies and procedures of respective departments in accordance with regulatory agencies and hospital policies.
* Manages inventory of reagents, calibrators, controls and supplies. Keeps the laboratory stocked with required supplies, submitting weekly orders in a timely manner. Assists in the prompt ordering, completion and review of the proficiency survey for all areas of the Lab, including the bedside testing. Keeps records of all testing organized (i.e. proficiency submitted, reviewed, problems resolved).
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Title: Remote WFH Response Associate, Roadside Assistance (CSR)
Description:
#### **About Agero:**

#### Wherever drivers go, we're leading the way. Agero's mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients' relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we're pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

**Note:** **For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.**

  

**Role Description and Mission: The Job & Why It Matters**

**Are you a quick-thinking problem solver who thrives on helping others in their time of need? Do you want to make a real difference and have a lasting impact on customers?**

Agero is actively seeking **Remote Response Associates** to join our **Roadside Assistance** department, where you will help rescue stranded customers off the side of the road. When a vehicle breaks down, you are the driver's first point of contact. Taking real-time inbound calls from motorists across the U.S., you will be the calming voice that turns an unpredictable, highly stressful situation into a solved problem. You will provide a clear roadmap of what they can expect next, guiding them through an urgent and unplanned event. Just like an everyday superhero, you are stepping in to save their day and get their plans back on track!

As a **Remote Response Associate**, you serve as a lifeline for customers facing roadside emergencies such as flat tires, lockouts, dead batteries, fuel deliveries, and towing due to mechanical failures. Because customers often reach out feeling overwhelmed or unsafe on the side of the road, in dark parking lots, or while traveling in unfamiliar areas, you will manage these high-stress situations with calm, empathetic guidance and consistent reassurance.

Leading with a customer-first mindset, you will coordinate directly with external service providers to ensure the accurate and rapid dispatch of tow trucks and service vehicles. Your ability to stay calm and make quick decisions under pressure directly impacts customer safety, satisfaction, and our reputation for service excellence as a trusted, industry-leading roadside provider.

  

**Key Outcomes:** **What you'll do**

* **Handle High-Volume Calls:** Gather essential details regarding location and vehicle issues to dispatch assistance quickly for stranded motorists in real-time.
* **Dispatch with Accuracy:** Coordinate efficiently with external service providers to ensure the right help arrives at the right time.
* **De-escalate & Support:** Use active listening and empathy to calm frustrated or anxious customers, navigating heightened emotions during uncertain situations.
* **Navigate Digital Tools:** Utilize multiple web-based systems and dispatch tools simultaneously to track service progress accurately.
* **Excel in a Virtual Team:** Thrive in a performance-driven remote environment, collaborating with peers and managers via Zoom and Google Chat.

  

**Skills, Education, & Experience:** **What We're Looking For**

This isn't your typical, script-reading customer service role. We have a high bar for talent because our drivers need real help in real-time. Every single call involves a stressful situation - some customers will be panicking, others might be crying, and many won't even know exactly where they are stranded. To succeed here, you need to bring your A-game every shift, every call.

**Here are the skills you'll bring to the team:**

* **Empathy in Action:** You have a natural ability to genuinely understand what a stranded driver is going through. You can authentically connect with people, stay patient, validate their fears, and give them the real reassurance they need when they are stuck in a dark parking lot or on a busy highway.
* **Effective Communication & Listening:** True communication starts with listening. You need to actively listen to absorb the critical details from a worried caller, ask the right questions, and probe for missing information. From there, you'll use a steady, confident voice to give clear directions to our roadside partners and explain the next steps to the customer so they feel completely guided.
* **Sound Judgment Under Pressure:** You don't fold when things get chaotic. You can keep a cool head, think clearly, and make smart, fast decisions during unpredictable events. You are comfortable thinking outside the box to solve problems safely, but you also have the awareness to know exactly when a situation needs to be escalated for extra help.
* **Problem-Solving & De-escalation:** You bring a calm, professional attitude to every interaction. You have a knack for turning a stressful, negative situation into a smooth, positive experience by focused problem-solving.
* **Multitasking Mastery:** You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two calls are identical. You can comfortably talk to a stranded driver or a tow provider while simultaneously typing detailed notes, navigating multiple screens, and pulling resources from our system without breaking your focus.
* **Service Excellence:** We leave no one stranded. You take total ownership of every single call and call-back. You don't just check a box or process a dispatch; you focus on the person behind the problem, ensuring both our customers and our roadside partners get high-quality, accurate, and timely support.
* **Tech Proficiency:** You are comfortable working with digital tools and fast-paced systems. You can confidently navigate online databases, CRMs, and complex dispatch software all at once. You are familiar with and comfortable using AI tools, a pro at using Google Maps to pinpoint exact locations, fluent in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Chat), and can type at least 30 WPM accurately without breaking the flow of a live conversation.
* **Accountability & Reliability:** Even in a remote environment, we hold our team to a high standard and operate a structured contact center with top-tier client expectations. select a dedicated production schedule with set days off. We require your consistent commitment to this schedule because a stranded driver is counting on you when you are on the clock. At the same time, due to the nature of our business, things move fast. Call volumes spike, schedules adjust, teams shift, and supervisors change - meaning you must be highly adaptable and ready to pivot.

  

**Position Requirements:**

* **Location:** You must currently physically reside in Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Missouri, Tennessee, or Virginia.
* **Customer-Facing Experience:** You bring 1+ years of continuous customer service experience, ideally in a fast-paced contact center environment. A steady work history, proven career growth, and previous remote experience are highly valued. We also love and look for transferable skills from retail, fast-food, hospitality, administrative, or warehouse/production environments!
* **Background Check:** You must successfully pass a comprehensive criminal background screening (covering 10 years for misdemeanors and a lifetime check for felonies) to protect customer security and client integrity.
* **Workspace Needs:** You must have a dedicated, quiet home office setup completely free from family, pet, or background noise. Associates are responsible for providing their own work equipment.

  

**Remote Technology Requirements (BYOD):**

To ensure you can support stranded drivers without technical lag, your home office setup must meet these exact specifications. We will verify your system using the Harver System Checker during the application process.

**Your PC & Equipment Setup:**

* **Computer:** A personal desktop or laptop manufactured in 2021 or later. Chromebooks, Macs, and tablets are not allowed.
* **Operating System:** A current, supported version of Windows 11 (specifically version 24H2, 25H2, or newer). *Important Note: Microsoft has discontinued support for older Windows 11 versions, so you must be updated to be eligible.*
* **Processor:** Intel or AMD with 2+ cores, minimum 3.5 GHz (boosted/turbo speed).
* **Memory & Storage:** Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 20 GB of free hard drive space.
* **Peripherals:** A working webcam (used for training & company meetings) and a high-quality USB-wired headset. Dual monitors are not required, but may be used if preferred.
* **Browser:** Google Chrome (version 23+) or Mozilla Firefox (version 3+).
* **Hardwired Internet:** A secure, hard-wired high-speed connection hooked directly into your router (modem) via an Ethernet cable. Wi-Fi is absolutely not allowed while working.
* **Required Internet Speeds:** Minimum **25 Mbps download** / 1**0 Mbps upload**. Maximum **latency up to 80ms–100ms**.
* **Mobile Device:** An active cell phone capable of receiving SMS text messages and downloading security apps for our mandatory two-step authentication process.

**What Will NOT Work (Incompatible Setups):**

* **Work-Issued PCs:** You must have full Administrator privileges to install our tools. Devices owned by previous employers and schools have strict security locks and cannot be used.
* **Incompatible Devices:** MacBooks, iPads, iMacs, Chromebooks, Surface Pro/Go, Samsung Notebooks, or any machines built before 2020.
* **Incompatible Connections:** Mobile hotspots, Wi-Fi, satellite internet, or USB phone tethering.
* **Banned Software:** Active VPNs, privacy/proxy services, or hosted/virtual PC platforms.
* **Unsupported OS:** All versions of Windows 10 and older, expired versions of Windows 11.

  

**Pay, Benefits, & Career Growth:**

* **Solid Starting Pay:** Earn a dependable base rate of **$16.25 per hour.**
* **Premium Shift Differentials & Incentives:** Boost your earnings with an **extra $1.75 to $2.50 per hour** **in shift differentials for working evenings, nights, and weekends.** You also have direct access to monthly performance and attendance bonuses, plus regular overtime opportunities based on business needs, and scheduled raises through merit increases.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package:** We have you covered. Enjoy a full suite of medical, dental, and vision insurance options, a 401(k) program with a company match, Paid Time Off (PTO), tuition reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), referral bonus program, complimentary roadside assistance, and more.
* **A Clear Path Upward:** We invest heavily in your future. You will have direct access to online skill-building courses, professional mentorship, and cross-training programs designed to give you the exact expertise you need to climb the ladder and fast-track your career at Agero.

  

**Start Dates, Training, & Production Schedules:**

* **Mandatory Paid Training:** To set you up for absolute success, 100% attendance is required during your first two weeks of mandatory classroom training (Monday–Friday). Because this foundational period is packed with essential learning, schedules cannot be modified. We assess performance throughout this time and look for opportunities to cross-train you to expand your skill set early on.
* **Skill Expansion, Cross-Training, & Professional Growth:** Participate in hands-on, cross-functional training to broaden your knowledge of roadside support, expanding your skillset across specialized lines of business.
* **Selecting Your Shift:** You will choose your full-time production schedule during the job offer process on a first-come, first-served basis. Training dates & schedules are set by Agero and based on business needs. The Roadside Assistance department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to support stranded motorists when they need us most. Available production schedules will vary by start date and are subject to change.
* **Schedule Commitment:** Your production schedule is static for your first 90 days after training. After this 90-day milestone, you become eligible to request schedule changes. Our team also participates in semi-annual shift bids to keep things fair and flexible.
* **24/7 Roadside Reality:** Because breakdowns don't take days off, we provide 24/7/365 coverage. This means most full-time production schedules include working at least one weekend day and holiday coverage. Full Time only. Weekend availability/flexibility is required.

Title: Resident Engineer
Description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To represent the Consultant on-site and lead the construction supervision team, ensuring that all project works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contract documents, applicable authority regulations, quality standards, HSE requirements, and approved project schedules. The Resident Engineer is responsible for overseeing the contractor's performance, managing the supervision team, coordinating with the client and stakeholders, and ensuring successful project delivery on behalf of the Consultant.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the Consultant's representative on-site and manage all construction supervision activities throughout the project.
* Lead, supervise, and coordinate the multidisciplinary supervision team, including Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical, Electrical, Infrastructure Engineers, and Inspectors.
* Ensure that all construction works are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contract documents, and applicable UAE regulations.
* Monitor and control the contractor's performance, construction progress, workmanship, and compliance with contractual obligations.
* Review and recommend approval of shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, technical submissions, and other contractor submissions in accordance with delegated authority.
* Review and manage RFIs, technical queries, inspection requests, and site-related correspondence, ensuring timely responses.
* Verify that materials delivered to the site comply with approved specifications and material submittals.
* Monitor the project programme, identify delays, assess their potential impact, and recommend corrective actions to maintain project milestones.
* Ensure proper implementation of the approved Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures.
* Monitor site safety practices and ensure that the contractor complies with approved HSE plans and applicable safety regulations.
* Conduct regular site inspections, progress meetings, technical meetings, and coordination meetings with the client and contractor.
* Review and certify interim payment applications based on actual site progress and completed works, subject to contractual authority.
* Review variations, claims, extension of time requests, and other contractual submissions, providing technical recommendations to the client and management.
* Issue site instructions, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and corrective action requests in accordance with the contract and delegated authority.
* Prepare and submit monthly progress reports, site reports, technical reports, and other project-related documentation.
* Coordinate with the client, contractor, design consultants, specialist subcontractors, and relevant authorities to resolve project-related issues.
* Monitor testing, commissioning, inspections, and authority approvals to ensure compliance with project requirements.
* Manage project completion activities, including snagging, de-snagging, substantial completion inspections, and final handover.
* Ensure proper maintenance of project records, correspondence, drawings, inspection reports, approvals, and contractual documentation.
* Report project risks, critical issues, delays, and contractual concerns to the Project Manager and Client in a timely manner.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a relevant Engineering discipline.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience in construction supervision and consultancy.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in a Resident Engineer or equivalent senior supervisory position.
* Proven experience in consultant-side supervision of large-scale construction projects, including high-rise towers, residential buildings, villas, commercial developments, and mixed-use projects.
* Extensive experience in managing multidisciplinary supervision teams.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC contract conditions, construction contracts, project specifications, and contract administration.
* Excellent knowledge of UAE construction regulations, Dubai Municipality requirements, and other relevant local authority standards.
* **PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is mandatory.**
* Valid UAE driving licence is preferred.
* Previous experience with major developers and consultants in the UAE is highly preferred.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and multidisciplinary team management capabilities.
* Excellent knowledge of construction supervision and consultancy practices.
* Strong contractual, commercial, and technical understanding.
* Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage project risks, resolve technical disputes, and handle complex site challenges.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, cost control, and risk management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare and review technical reports, contractual correspondence, and project documentation.
* Strong decision-making, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple project priorities.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Compliance of construction works with approved drawings, specifications, and contractual requirements.
* Effective supervision and management of the consultant's site team.
* Timely review and response to technical submissions and RFIs.
* Effective monitoring of contractor progress and project milestones.
* Quality of construction supervision and reduction of repeated non-conformities.
* Effective contract administration and timely reporting of variations and claims.
* Compliance with HSE requirements.
* Timely completion of project inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Client satisfaction and quality of consultancy services.

Title: Office Coordinator - MENA
Description:

The MENA Office Coordinator provides practical, hands-on administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of Flint Culture's Dubai office and wider MENA operations.

Reporting to the Global Operations Manager and working closely with the HR Director and Finance team, the role supports office coordination, employee administration, compliance tracking, travel arrangements and general operational activities.

We're looking for someone who is naturally proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused - someone who thinks ahead, spots potential issues early and takes the initiative to find practical solutions. This is a varied role for someone who enjoys making things happen, takes pride in being organised and can work independently, using good judgement and knowing when to seek guidance.

Ideally, candidates will already hold valid UAE residency sponsorship and have their own medical insurance cover.

  

### **Main Duties & Responsibilities**

  

**Founder Support**

* Provide occasional administrative and practical support to the Founder as required, including coordinating documents, signatures and other routine requests.
* Assist with the day-to-day coordination of the Founder's driver, including scheduling, holiday booking, communication and practical arrangements.

**Office & Team Support**

* Coordinate the day-to-day running of the Dubai office, including supplies, facilities, maintenance and general office requirements.
* Help create a welcoming, professional and positive environment for employees and visitors.
* Liaise with office suppliers, building management and service providers as needed.
* Help organise team activities, celebrations and office events within agreed budgets.
* Act as a first point of contact for general office and administrative queries.

**General Administration & Operational Support**

* Assist with travel arrangements, bookings and other administrative requirements for the MENA team.
* Maintain organised electronic files, records, templates and trackers.
* Support the preparation and submission of routine business documentation, including registrations, supplier forms and tender administration.
* Help coordinate day-to-day operational tasks and follow up on outstanding actions.
* Provide general administrative support to the Global Operations Manager and wider team as required.

**Compliance & Renewal Administration**

* Maintain and update the Business Compliance & Renewals calendar, including company licences, registrations, visas and insurance renewals.
* Track important dates, organise supporting documentation and flag upcoming deadlines.
* Liaise with PROs, government service providers and internal colleagues to coordinate visa applications for new joiners, renewals, registrations and other required submissions, ensuring documentation is complete and deadlines are met.
* Ensure records and documentation are accurately maintained and filed.

**HR Administration**

* Support employee on-boarding and off-boarding, including local documentation, visas, insurance and practical arrangements.

* Maintain accurate and appropriately filed employee documentation and records.

* Maintain an accurate inventory of company equipment, including allocations, returns and replacements.
* Liaise with external IT support to coordinate equipment setup, resolve basic technical issues and ensure timely removal of access for leavers.
* Manage day-to-day IT support requests from the team, monitor outstanding tickets, follow up with IT support and escalating unresolved, urgent or recurring problems to the Global Operations Manager.

* Assist with processing and tracking supplier invoices, office expenses and payment requests.
* Maintain records of office expenditure, subscriptions and supplier costs.
* Obtain quotations and help coordinate supplier renewals and purchases.
* Ensure invoices, receipts and supporting documentation are provided to Finance.
* Flag discrepancies, unexpected charges or outstanding payments to the relevant team.

We're looking for someone who:

* *Is a natural problem solver* - approaches challenges with curiosity, common sense and a can-do attitude.
* *Thinks ahead and takes initiative* - anticipates what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
* *Is resourceful and solutions-focused* - looks for practical ways to resolve issues and brings suggestions when flagging problems.
* *Takes ownership* - follows tasks through to completion and doesn't let things fall between the cracks.
* *Is highly organised and detail-oriented* - stays on top of deadlines, records and competing priorities.
* *Is numerically confident and financially aware* - comfortable working with figures, understands the importance of budgets and costs, and has a good head for numbers.
* *Is confident working independently* - uses good judgement, knows when to make things happen and when to escalate.
* *Is approachable and collaborative* - enjoys helping others and building positive working relationships.
* *Is adaptable and willing to learn* - comfortable with technology, new systems and changing priorities.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

  

* Previous experience in office coordination, administration, team support or a similar role.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to handle confidential information securely.
* Confidence using Google Workspace or similar office applications.
* Ability to manage routine administrative tasks and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable liaising with colleagues, suppliers and external service providers.
* Experience working in the UAE is desirable.
* Familiarity with UAE visa, PRO or business administration processes would be an advantage but is not essential.
* Fluent English; Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential.
* Willing and able to travel to our Abu Dhabi office as required to provide operational and administrative support.

  

### **Why join us?**

  

* People first approach - we want to develop a deep sense of belonging & inclusion for all our people.
* Culture for Good - our strengths based culture is an important touchpoint in our overall employee experience.
* Our footprint is growing - we deliver campaigns worldwide through offices in the UK and Middle East, supported by an international network of consultants.
* Multidisciplinary teams - providing integrated communications services across strategy, media relations, marketing, content creation and social media.
* Breadth of experience - varied work across the cultural and creative industries, spanning different disciplines and targeting both consumer and industry audiences.

### **About Flint Culture**

We are an international culture-led communications and strategy consultancy firm. As believers in the transformative power of culture, we work at the intersection of arts and cultural intelligence to drive meaningful change, amplify impact and foster connections. Through our in-market teams across the UK, Europe, the Middle East and South Asia.

**Company:** Fourth Command

**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site

1. Job Overview

Fourth Command is seeking qualified and technically competent Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultants for a cybersecurity consulting engagement with a reputed government organization in Qatar.

The position requires strong technical and functional expertise in information security governance, cybersecurity risk management, regulatory compliance, security architecture, information security auditing, and cybersecurity training and awareness.

The selected candidates will be responsible for assessing the organization's cybersecurity posture, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying security and compliance deficiencies, developing governance frameworks, and recommending appropriate security improvements.

Candidates must possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, with the ability to independently conduct assessments, manage stakeholder engagements, deliver cybersecurity training, and prepare professional consulting deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

2. Key Responsibilities2.1. Information Security Governance

* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Support the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Develop cybersecurity strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance processes, and security improvement plans.
* Establish information security roles, responsibilities, accountability mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of information security policies and governance requirements.

2.2. Cybersecurity Risk Management

* Independently conduct enterprise-level, asset-level, application-level, process-level, and project-specific cybersecurity risk assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and associated business and operational impacts.
* Develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, cybersecurity risk registers, risk treatment plans, and risk acceptance documentation.
* Evaluate security control effectiveness and determine inherent and residual risk exposure.
* Recommend appropriate technical, administrative, and operational controls to mitigate identified risks.
* Monitor risk treatment activities, validate remediation effectiveness, and escalate critical or unresolved risks.

2.3. Regulatory Compliance and Security Audits

* Conduct compliance assessments, gap assessments, security maturity assessments, and internal information security audits against applicable national and international cybersecurity frameworks.
* Assess organizational compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA), NIST CSF, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop compliance matrices, control mappings, Statements of Applicability (SoA), audit reports, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, technical walkthroughs, and evidence-based security control assessments.
* Support regulatory inspections, external audits, and cybersecurity certification initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments, track compliance deficiencies, and validate the implementation of corrective actions.

2.4. Security Architecture and Technical Security Assessments

* Review and assess enterprise security architecture, network architecture, infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, and application security architecture.
* Interpret and evaluate network topology diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, data flows, system integrations, and security control placement.
* Identify architectural weaknesses, insecure configurations, inadequate security controls, and potential cybersecurity exposures.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology implementations, infrastructure changes, applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Assess the implementation and effectiveness of technical security controls across the following domains:
* Network Security and Network Segmentation.
* Endpoint and Server Security.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Cloud and Application Security.
* Data Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Vulnerability and Patch Management.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR and XDR.
* Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
* Encryption and Cryptographic Controls.
* System Hardening and Security Configuration.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Review vulnerability assessment reports, penetration testing reports, security configurations, and technical assessment findings to determine associated business risks.
* Evaluate cybersecurity technologies against organizational security requirements and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Apply Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles during security architecture assessments.

2.5. Third-Party Risk Management and Data Privacy

* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments of vendors, suppliers, service providers, and technology partners.
* Review third-party security practices, contractual cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory compliance obligations.
* Develop and maintain third-party risk registers, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
* Assess organizational data protection and privacy practices against applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop and review data classification, information handling, data retention, and data protection requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of data security controls and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

2.6. Business Continuity and Incident Management

* Review and assess Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and cybersecurity incident response plans.
* Support Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and evaluate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Assess organizational preparedness for cybersecurity incidents and operational disruptions.
* Develop and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises, incident response simulations, and business continuity exercises.
* Review incident investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.

2.7. Cybersecurity Training and Awareness

* Develop, implement, and maintain organizational cybersecurity training and awareness programs.
* Independently prepare professional training materials, presentations, educational content, and cybersecurity awareness campaigns.
* Conduct cybersecurity training sessions for employees, management, technical personnel, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop role-based training programs aligned with organizational functions and associated cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct specialized workshops covering cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, data protection, and secure working practices.
* Support phishing simulation exercises and other cybersecurity awareness initiatives.
* Establish training schedules, performance indicators, and mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness.

2.8. Security Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Develop and maintain cybersecurity Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and security performance measurement frameworks.
* Prepare professional risk assessment reports, compliance reports, audit reports, and technical security assessment reports.
* Develop executive dashboards, management presentations, cybersecurity roadmaps, and periodic security performance reports.
* Monitor outstanding cybersecurity risks, compliance deficiencies, remediation activities, and security improvement initiatives.
* Present technical findings, business risks, and security recommendations to technical teams and senior management.

2.9. Stakeholder Management and Consulting

* Independently conduct client meetings, stakeholder interviews, technical discussions, and cybersecurity workshops.
* Coordinate with business functions, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, auditors, and senior management.
* Provide professional cybersecurity advisory services and technically feasible recommendations.
* Effectively communicate complex technical findings and cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned consulting activities, project commitments, and deliverables in accordance with established timelines and quality standards.

3. Required Qualifications and Skills3.1. Education and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* A minimum of three years of directly relevant professional experience in GRC, information security consulting, cybersecurity risk management, or information security auditing.
* Demonstrable experience in independently conducting risk assessments, compliance assessments, information security audits, and technical security control reviews.
* Practical experience in developing security policies, procedures, risk registers, compliance matrices, and professional assessment reports.
* Experience in reviewing security architecture and evaluating technical cybersecurity controls.
* Experience in developing and delivering cybersecurity training, awareness sessions, and stakeholder workshops.

3.2. Knowledge of Standards and Regulatory Frameworks

Candidates must possess strong knowledge and practical understanding of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulatory frameworks, including:

* ISO/IEC 27002 – Information Security Controls.
* ISO/IEC 27005 – Information Security Risk Management.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.

3.3. Technical Knowledge and Competencies

Candidates must demonstrate strong technical knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, including:

3.4. Communication and Professional Skills

* Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with the ability to conduct training sessions and confidently engage with senior management and government stakeholders.

Candidates must be willing to relocate to Qatar, independently manage assigned responsibilities, adhere to project delivery timelines, and maintain consistent quality across all deliverables.

· Set and tags merchandise in customer store(s)

· Marketing product on store shelves with the aid of plan-o-grams

· Recommends and incorporates new product lines to store sets

· Authorizes and documents the return of un-saleable product for customer credit

· Assist, when necessary, in the delivery or pick-up of product

· Maintains the inventory of all merchandising supplies

· Communicates with team leaders and managers of the store to work out the floor layout and display points, needed expansion of key categories, as well as how and what items are to be displayed

· Responsible for the presentation and replenishment of merchandise in assigned location(s)

· Ensures that merchandise is displayed, rotated and correct signage is present

· Monitors stock status and replenishing needs

· Ensures that floors and shelves are free of debris and trash

· Learn group plan-o-grams for proper merchandising in accounts

· All other duties and projects as assigned

**Position Requirements:**

Title: Senior Financial Analyst
Description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst to join our Financial & Property Management Consultancy team. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in developing complex master community and building operating expense and service charge models, including service charge apportionment, lifecycle costing analysis, and reserve fund assessment. This role demands exceptional presentation skills, the ability to manage projects and client reporting, and a proactive approach to supporting the line manager in developing innovative, market-leading solutions that enhance real estate performance and optimisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Project Execution:**  
Develop complex master community and property service charge models in line with RICS guidelines and operational requirements, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in calculating service charges for multiple asset classes within developments.
  
Develop service charge apportionment methodologies as per the best market practices, considering factors such as property size, tenancy, usage, and common areas allocation.
  
Collaborate with external parties to review, assess, and periodically update service rate cards to reflect market trends, changes in service scope, or new services introduced by facilities management companies.
  
Interpret development master plans and designs, encompassing architectural and engineering drawings, for the purpose of establishing services to estimate operating expenses and transform these into service charge regimes.
  
Use excellent presentation skills to effectively communicate complex financial concepts, including service charge apportionment, service charge recovery, and the implications of void costs, to clients and stakeholders.
  
Develop lifecycle costing models for building and community assets, forecasting replacement, renewal, and major maintenance costs over the asset life based on asset registers, useful life, condition, inflation, and escalation assumptions.
  
Develop reserve fund models and assessments, including reserve fund contribution requirements and funding strategies, in line with RICS guidelines and applicable local regulations, to ensure adequate funding for future capital expenditure.
  
Integrate lifecycle costing and reserve fund contributions into service charge budgets and apportionment, and conduct periodic reviews of reserve fund adequacy, shortfalls, and scenario or sensitivity analysis.
  
Present lifecycle costing and reserve fund findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders, supporting long-term capital planning and decision-making.
  
Conduct in-depth analysis of real estate operating expenses, comparing trends, and benchmarking results against industry standards across the GCC region.
  
Manage client financial reporting requirements, including the preparation of financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of reports.
  
Create interactive dashboards and reports for C-suite executives, presenting key financial metrics, performance analysis, key cost and revenue drivers, and strategic recommendations.
  
  
**Project Management:**  
Manage and execute project deliverables within established timelines.
  
Interpret and evaluate the requirements of Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams/departments to develop Technical and Commercial proposals.
  
Ensure timely delivery of project deliverables and compliance with client requirements.
  
Continuously monitor project progress against risk, timelines and deliverables, adjusting plans and resources to ensure successful delivery.
  
  
**Client Management and Business Development:**  
Travel to the GCC region, whenever required, to attend client meetings, workshops and presentations.
  
Build and foster strong client relationships to establish trust and understanding to provide tailored operational financial solutions.
  
Identify and pursue business development opportunities to drive the growth of the Financial & Property Management Consultancy business including generating and qualifying leads and contributing to the preparation and submission of compelling new business proposals.
  
  
**Education:**  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, real estate, or a related field. A professional certification (CA, ACCA, CMA, CPA, RICS, etc.) is preferred.
  
  
**Experience & Skills:**  
3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, service charge, or property and asset management consultancy, within the KSA or UAE real estate market.
  
Proven experience in developing complex master community and building service charge models.
  
In-depth knowledge of service charge apportionment methodologies.
  
Proven experience in lifecycle costing and reserve fund modeling and assessment for building and community assets.
  
Strong understanding of real estate financial reporting, including the preparation of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  
Proficiency in financial modeling and analysis software (e.g., Excel, Power BI, etc.).
  
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial concepts to diverse audiences.
  
Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of real estate development and operations.
  
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  
Willingness to travel across the GCC region, whenever required, for client meetings, presentations, and industry events.
  
Ability to support the line manager in developing new consultancy products and services, through market research, competitive analysis, and client insights.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Title: AVP, Retail Products
Description:
**Description**
---------------

  

Reporting to the Vice President & Head of Retail Products and Portfolio Yield Management, Manulife Bank, the AVP, Retail Products is responsible for leading the Bank’s retail product strategy, portfolio performance and transformation agenda across day-to-day banking products and experience, including deposits, credit cards, ATM and debit payments, and unsecured credit strategy. The role has full P&L accountability for the deposit and credit card portfolios, with support from the Pricing and Yield Management team to optimize pricing, margin and portfolio yield. The portfolio represents a significant opportunity to deepen customer relationships, grow primary banking relationships and deliver sustainable earnings growth for Manulife Bank.

  

The AVP, Retail Products bridges strategy and execution. The incumbent sets the direction for the retail product portfolio, makes product, investment and portfolio trade-off decisions, and ensures that product propositions, customer experiences and operating capabilities deliver value for customers and the Bank. The AVP is accountable for overall portfolio growth and financial outcomes, including acquisition, activation, engagement and volume delivery. In fulfilling this role, the incumbent will partner across the Bank, including Pricing and Yield Management, Data and Analytics, Marketing, Sales, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Operations and Delivery, to deliver high-quality products, experiences and business outcomes.

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership (20%)

  

* Develop, monitor and refine the medium- and long-term strategy for the retail product portfolio, aligned to the Bank’s customer, growth and earnings objectives
* Own the strategic product roadmap and prioritize investments across deposits, credit cards, payments, unsecured credit, relationship banking and day-to-day banking experiences
* Define compelling product propositions, features and lifecycle strategies that strengthen the Bank’s competitive position and deepen customer relationships
* Lead the development of investment business cases and recommend the sequencing of initiatives based on customer value, strategic fit, economics, risk and delivery capacity
* Use customer, market, channel and competitive insights to identify opportunities and inform product and portfolio decisions
  

  

Product Portfolio and P&L Management (20%)

  

* Own the full P&L for the deposit and credit card portfolios, including balances, revenue, margin, expenses, losses and profitability
* Establish product-level performance objectives and operating routines to identify opportunities, address performance gaps and improve portfolio economics
* Make portfolio and P&L trade-offs across growth, customer value, risk, pricing, incentives and investment priorities
* Partner with Pricing and Yield Management to establish pricing and promotional guardrails, optimize margin and yield, and balance customer and financial outcomes
* Oversee product lifecycle decisions, including the launch, enhancement, simplification or retirement of products, features and services
* Provide oversight of credit card product operations, vendor performance, ATM and debit payments, and related customer and operational outcomes
  

  

Transformation and Delivery (30%)

  

* Lead the transformation of the Bank’s day-to-day banking products and customer experiences, with a focus on creating simpler, more connected and relationship-led banking experiences
* Drive the introduction of relationship banking capabilities and new product experiences that support customer growth, engagement and deeper primary banking relationships
* Set transformation priorities and ensure delivery plans remain aligned to the product strategy, target customer experience and expected business benefits
* Partner with Technology, Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into clear requirements, prioritized roadmaps and high-quality solutions
* Oversee execution from concept through launch, including planning, readiness, testing, implementation, adoption and benefit realization
* Provide clear updates to senior leadership on progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, financial performance and outcomes
  

  

Leadership and Building a High Performing Team (15%)

  

* Lead a team of product management professionals with accountability spanning customer growth and campaigns, product and P&L optimization, unsecured credit strategy, and day-to-day banking transformation
* Inspire, coach, guide and actively engage employees; establish clear accountabilities, performance standards and decision rights
* Build product management capability through focused development, coaching, career discussions and succession planning
* Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture that encourages constructive challenge, sound judgment and enterprise thinking
* Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners to align priorities, resolve trade-offs and deliver customer and business outcomes
  

  

Governance, Risk and Controls (15%)

  

* Act as the first-line business owner for product regulatory compliance, product controls and the ongoing soundness of the retail product portfolio
* Own and oversee product-related corrective action plans, remediation activities and sustainable control improvements
* Ensure effective vendor and partner oversight, including clear performance expectations, governance, issue management and escalation
* Oversee customer communications, forms, disclosures and product collateral to ensure accuracy, consistency and regulatory compliance
* Maintain effective product approval and lifecycle governance, ensuring risks, controls, customer impacts and operational readiness are considered in all material decisions
* Promote strong operational resilience and ensure material product, customer and operational risks are identified, understood and addressed
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  
  

* 10+ years of progressive banking, product management, financial management or business transformation experience
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics or a related field
* Demonstrated experience leading deposit and credit card product portfolios
* Strong P&L ownership and financial management experience, including the ability to make portfolio trade-offs and deliver profitable growth
* Leadership experience in strategic planning, business casing, product roadmaps, transformation delivery and cross-functional execution
* Demonstrated knowledge of banking regulation, product governance, first-line risk management and control frameworks
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders and partners across the Bank
* Proven people leadership experience, including building capability, developing talent and leading through change
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
  

* MBA or another business-oriented post-graduate qualification is an asset
* Experience with transformation and agile delivery methodologies
* Experience with vendor management, payments, unsecured credit or relationship banking is an asset
  

  

**When you join our team:**

  
  

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
