Title: KCC - Medical Assistant FT/Day
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY** : Provides clinical and administrative support to healthcare providers in a rural health clinic setting. Serves as a key member of the care team by assisting with patient intake, documentation, care coordination, preventive health services, and communication between patients and providers. Promotes a positive patient experience while supporting the efficient delivery of quality healthcare services. Performs other duties as assigned.

**PERFORMANCE DIMENSIONS AND TASKS**  
Essential Job Functions
  
The duties listed below are the essential functions of this position. Employees must be able to perform these essential functions, with or without reasonable accommodation. This list is intended to describe the primary responsibilities of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties. Additional job-related duties may be assigned as needed.
  

* Functions as a team member and provides medical support to providers, nursing staff, front office staff, Call Center and other members of the care team.
* Performs assigned duties after demonstrating competency and in accordance with approved policies, procedures, standardized procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Promotes efficient patient flow by preparing patients, rooms, equipment, and required documentation in a timely manner.
* Assists front office staff with patient needs when appropriate and utilizes clinic resources to resolve questions or concerns.
* Recognizes and appropriately escalates complex or urgent patient concerns to the appropriate supervisor, provider, or member of the care team.
* Assists providers with patient communication and interpretation when appropriate and within the Medical Assistant's training and organizational guidelines.
* Utilizes approved interpreter services when required or when interpretation needs are beyond the Medical Assistant's role or competency.
* Reviews the California Immunization Registry (CAIR) to verify the patient's immunization history and identify vaccines that may be due or missing.
* Compares immunization records in CAIR with the patient's electronic medical record (EMR) and updates the EMR as appropriate according to established policies and procedures.
* Communicates identified immunization needs to the provider and assists with coordinating recommended vaccinations.
* Follows Vaccines for Children (VFC) program guidelines and clinic policies when handling, documenting, and administering VFC vaccines.
* Verifies patient eligibility for VFC vaccines and ensures required documentation is completed accurately.
* Maintains accurate vaccine documentation in the EMR and applicable immunization registry.
* Follows established procedures for vaccine storage, handling, inventory, administration, and documentation.
* Reports vaccine discrepancies, storage concerns, or other VFC-related issues to the appropriate supervisor or designated staff member.
* Assists with orientation and onboarding of new Medical Assistants, externs, and students.

Collects, documents, and maintains accurate patient information
  

* Obtains and documents information related to the patient's chief complaint, history of present illness, medical history, family history, and social history, as appropriate.
* Gathers and enters information into the medical record accurately and in accordance with established standards.
* Completes required documentation based on clinic policies, procedures, visit type, programs, and payer requirements.
* Reviews and documents current medications, including prescription medications, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, including medication name, strength, dosage, frequency, and route, to support provider medication reconciliation.
* Reviews and documents patient allergies, including medication, food, and environmental allergies.
* Obtains and verifies required patient information at each visit in accordance with current policies, procedures, standardized procedures, and approved medical record templates.
* Accurately obtains and documents vital signs and other required measurements, including height/length, weight, BMI, blood pressure, temperature, pulse, respirations, pain level, head circumference, and growth measurements when indicated.
* Completes pre-visit preparation and chart review/scrub activities as assigned.

Manages and communicates patient information in a timely and professional manner
  

* Regularly monitors assigned electronic medical record (EMR) message inboxes and responds to or routes messages according to established workflows.
* Communicates relevant patient information to the provider or appropriate member of the care team in an organized and timely manner, including the date, time, patient information, and nature of the concern.
* Keeps patients informed regarding their care and clinic processes throughout their visit.
* Demonstrates professional, respectful, and cooperative communication with patients, families, providers, and coworkers.
* Documents patient interactions and communications, including face-to-face, telephone, and electronic communications, in accordance with established documentation standards.
* Protects patient confidentiality and follows applicable privacy and security requirements.

Maintains clean, safe, and properly stocked patient care areas
  

* Cleans and restocks examination rooms after each patient encounter.
* Ensures examination rooms are stocked daily with appropriate supplies and equipment.
* Maintains examination rooms, nurse stations, and procedure areas in a clean, organized, and safe condition.
* Follows current infection prevention and control standards for cleaning, disinfecting, sanitizing, and handling equipment and supplies used in patient care.
* Properly handles and disposes of regulated medical and biohazardous waste according to established policies and procedures.

Maintains and handles medical equipment appropriately
  

* Cleans and prepares reusable surgical and medical instruments according to established procedures and prepares equipment for sterilization through the appropriate process.
* Transports instruments to the designated area for sterilization using approved containers and procedures.
* Performs routine equipment checks and promptly reports damaged, malfunctioning, or unsafe equipment to the appropriate supervisor or designated department.

Performs laboratory testing and specimen collection
  

* Collects and prepares specimens according to current laboratory policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Completes laboratory requisitions accurately, including required patient demographics and two patient identifiers.
* Labels specimens accurately and legibly using the required patient identifiers and follows appropriate specimen handling, storage, and transportation procedures.
* Performs approved point-of-care testing under written orders, standardized procedures, and within demonstrated competency.
* Accurately documents laboratory and point-of-care test results in the medical record and follows established procedures for reporting abnormal or critical results.

Provides clinical and administrative support to providers, nursing staff, and clinic management as assigned
  

* Assists with maintaining appropriate inventory levels of medications, medical supplies, and other patient care materials.
* Assists with referral coordination and related patient care activities as directed.
* Assists with scheduling patient follow-up appointments, including physical examinations and other recommended follow-up visits, based on provider recommendations and established scheduling guidelines.
* Assists with coordinating and scheduling in-house referrals to specialists and other services as directed by the provider.
* Administers medications and injections when permitted by applicable law, training, competency, provider order, and clinic policy.
* Ensures laboratory, diagnostic, and other patient reports are brought to the attention of the appropriate provider, with abnormal results prioritized according to established procedures.
* Assists with patient eligibility, case management activities, and health education using resources approved by the medical staff.
* Assists with nursing and clinical support assignments within the MA's training, competency, and scope of practice.
* Supports care coordination and other clinic workflows as assigned.

Supports training and development of staff
  

* Assists with orientation and training of new Medical Assistants and Medical Assistant externs.
* Serves as a resource and role model for new staff by demonstrating appropriate clinical, documentation, communication, and workflow practices.
* Provides feedback to the appropriate supervisor regarding training needs or competency concerns.

* Performs other duties as assigned within the scope of the position, demonstrated competency, applicable laws and regulations, and organizational policies and procedures.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
Education
  

* Completion of certified MA program and a passing score of at least 80% on a Mee Memorial Clinic Medical Dose Calculation Pre-placement test – Required
* High School diploma or equivalent - Required

Licensing
  

* Current American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers - Required

Work Experience
  

* None

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  

* Knowledge of outpatient clinical practices, infection prevention principles, and patient confidentiality requirements.
* Skill in accurately obtaining, documenting, and maintaining patient information and medical records.
* Skill in organizing and prioritizing work while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with patients, providers, and other members of the healthcare team.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and recognize situations requiring escalation to a provider, nurse, or supervisor.

Language Requirements
  

* Bilingual (English/Spanish) - Required

Physical Requirements
  

* Must be able to sit and stand/walk for 12 hours per day. Must be able to bend, push/pull and lift up to 50 pounds.

Working Conditions
  

* Works primarily in a rural health clinic environment with frequent interaction with patients, families, providers, and other healthcare personnel.
* May be exposed to communicable diseases, blood, body fluids, sharps, regulated medical waste, and other potentially infectious materials.
* Requires adherence to infection prevention, safety, confidentiality, and occupational health requirements.
* Frequent use of computers, electronic medical record systems, medical equipment, and standard office equipment.
* Subject to interruptions, changing priorities, and varying patient volumes throughout the workday

* Assists with orientation and onboarding of new Medical Assistants, externs, and students.

Collects, documents, and maintains accurate patient information
  

* Obtains and documents information related to the patient's chief complaint, history of present illness, medical history, family history, and social history, as appropriate.
* Gathers and enters information into the medical record accurately and in accordance with established standards.
* Completes required documentation based on clinic policies, procedures, visit type, programs, and payer requirements.
* Reviews and documents current medications, including prescription medications, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, including medication name, strength, dosage, frequency, and route, to support provider medication reconciliation.
* Reviews and documents patient allergies, including medication, food, and environmental allergies.
* Obtains and verifies required patient information at each visit in accordance with current policies, procedures, standardized procedures, and approved medical record templates.
* Accurately obtains and documents vital signs and other required measurements, including height/length, weight, BMI, blood pressure, temperature, pulse, respirations, pain level, head circumference, and growth measurements when indicated.
* Completes pre-visit preparation and chart review/scrub activities as assigned.

Manages and communicates patient information in a timely and professional manner
  

* Regularly monitors assigned electronic medical record (EMR) message inboxes and responds to or routes messages according to established workflows.
* Communicates relevant patient information to the provider or appropriate member of the care team in an organized and timely manner, including the date, time, patient information, and nature of the concern.
* Keeps patients informed regarding their care and clinic processes throughout their visit.
* Demonstrates professional, respectful, and cooperative communication with patients, families, providers, and coworkers.
* Documents patient interactions and communications, including face-to-face, telephone, and electronic communications, in accordance with established documentation standards.
* Protects patient confidentiality and follows applicable privacy and security requirements.

Maintains clean, safe, and properly stocked patient care areas
  

* Cleans and restocks examination rooms after each patient encounter.
* Ensures examination rooms are stocked daily with appropriate supplies and equipment.
* Maintains examination rooms, nurse stations, and procedure areas in a clean, organized, and safe condition.
* Follows current infection prevention and control standards for cleaning, disinfecting, sanitizing, and handling equipment and supplies used in patient care.
* Properly handles and disposes of regulated medical and biohazardous waste according to established policies and procedures.

Maintains and handles medical equipment appropriately
  

* Cleans and prepares reusable surgical and medical instruments according to established procedures and prepares equipment for sterilization through the appropriate process.
* Transports instruments to the designated area for sterilization using approved containers and procedures.
* Performs routine equipment checks and promptly reports damaged, malfunctioning, or unsafe equipment to the appropriate supervisor or designated department.

Performs laboratory testing and specimen collection
  

* Collects and prepares specimens according to current laboratory policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Completes laboratory requisitions accurately, including required patient demographics and two patient identifiers.
* Labels specimens accurately and legibly using the required patient identifiers and follows appropriate specimen handling, storage, and transportation procedures.
* Performs approved point-of-care testing under written orders, standardized procedures, and within demonstrated competency.
* Accurately documents laboratory and point-of-care test results in the medical record and follows established procedures for reporting abnormal or critical results.

Provides clinical and administrative support to providers, nursing staff, and clinic management as assigned
  

* Assists with maintaining appropriate inventory levels of medications, medical supplies, and other patient care materials.
* Assists with referral coordination and related patient care activities as directed.
* Assists with scheduling patient follow-up appointments, including physical examinations and other recommended follow-up visits, based on provider recommendations and established scheduling guidelines.
* Assists with coordinating and scheduling in-house referrals to specialists and other services as directed by the provider.
* Administers medications and injections when permitted by applicable law, training, competency, provider order, and clinic policy.
* Ensures laboratory, diagnostic, and other patient reports are brought to the attention of the appropriate provider, with abnormal results prioritized according to established procedures.
* Assists with patient eligibility, case management activities, and health education using resources approved by the medical staff.
* Assists with nursing and clinical support assignments within the MA's training, competency, and scope of practice.
* Supports care coordination and other clinic workflows as assigned.

Supports training and development of staff
  

* Assists with orientation and training of new Medical Assistants and Medical Assistant externs.
* Serves as a resource and role model for new staff by demonstrating appropriate clinical, documentation, communication, and workflow practices.
* Provides feedback to the appropriate supervisor regarding training needs or competency concerns.

* Performs other duties as assigned within the scope of the position, demonstrated competency, applicable laws and regulations, and organizational policies and procedures.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
Education
  

* Completion of certified MA program and a passing score of at least 80% on a Mee Memorial Clinic Medical Dose Calculation Pre-placement test – Required
* High School diploma or equivalent - Required

Licensing
  

* Current American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers - Required

Work Experience
  

* None

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  

* Knowledge of outpatient clinical practices, infection prevention principles, and patient confidentiality requirements.
* Skill in accurately obtaining, documenting, and maintaining patient information and medical records.
* Skill in organizing and prioritizing work while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with patients, providers, and other members of the healthcare team.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and recognize situations requiring escalation to a provider, nurse, or supervisor.

Language Requirements
  

* Bilingual (English/Spanish) - Required

Physical Requirements
  

* Must be able to sit and stand/walk for 12 hours per day. Must be able to bend, push/pull and lift up to 50 pounds.

Working Conditions
  

* Works primarily in a rural health clinic environment with frequent interaction with patients, families, providers, and other healthcare personnel.
* May be exposed to communicable diseases, blood, body fluids, sharps, regulated medical waste, and other potentially infectious materials.
* Requires adherence to infection prevention, safety, confidentiality, and occupational health requirements.
* Frequent use of computers, electronic medical record systems, medical equipment, and standard office equipment.
* Subject to interruptions, changing priorities, and varying patient volumes throughout the workday

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Title: Senior Customer Demand Planner
Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible**

You will oversee demand planning activities for your assigned product families in your business unit. You will also lead the demand review process and driving interactions with the cross-functional teams.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Lead the demand management agenda for the category, being the key interface between commercial (sales revenue planning) and supply (replenishment) to identify and evaluate the impact of potential availability issues/commercial changes including gap assessment and risk and opportunity discussions
* Partner with modelling team for the generation of statistical forecasting
* Manage, coach and develop a team
* Review standard consumption versus forecast at the customer and total product levels, liaising with replenishment and sales revenue planning to manage potential availability issues and the impact of under consumption
* Drive strong linkages with the commercial, customer collaboration, modelling, order fulfilment teams and supply planning including innovation and equity
* Drive continuous capability building in the demand planning team for planning improvement

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Comprehensive supply chain, economic, financial or logistics experience and commercial awareness in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment
* Open to learn new ways of working and is willing to use new tools
* Experience driving demand review and participation in an IBP cycle
* Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on the key priorities and improving the plan
* Able to build effective teams
* Knowledge in leading practice demand planning and end-to-end supply chain concepts
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills and verbal and written communication skills

**More about this role**

This will be a customer-facing role that will work closely with the Sales team and where relationships exist with the customer demand counterparts, in forecast generation for all categories. This role will be responsible for achieving customer forecast performance targets.

You will develop the 0-12-month IBP forecast by promoted planning group and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, sales strategy and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your bottom up build on categories and strategy and structure discussions
* Liaise with the commercial teams, operations team and customer (where applicable) and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families
* Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months)
* Interact with modelling team to validate statistical forecasting
* Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool from a customer bottom-up build.
* Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast errors and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast-moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint
* Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment
* Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills – and able to understand and interpret data
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Team player who can work with many other functions daily

**Education and experience :**

* Bachelor degree

* Ideal candidate will have 3-5 years’ experience within supply chain with proficiency in data analytics and gathering fact-based insight based on trends;

This role will work very closely with the Sales team but will have interaction with Category Demand team, Finance, Sales support and CS&L teams; Experience leading Consensus forums where negotiation and influencing skills will be essential.

We’re looking for someone with data analytics experience that would want to grow in this role.

**Travel requirements:**

Periodic customer meetings in the future.

**Work structur**e :

Monday to Friday ( hybrid )

Salary and Benefits:The expected base salary range for this position is $93,300 to $116,650 CAD depending on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to participate in a highly competitive bonus program.Mondelez also offers several generous employee benefits (some subsidized or fully paid for by the company), including health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, and enhanced vacation and holiday entitlements.AI may be used as part of the recruitment process and in accordance with local laws.This posting is for a current vacancy.No Relocation support available

With several brands that are among consumer favourites, including Cadbury, OREO, Christie and Maynards, we are one of the largest snack companies in Canada. Many of our iconic brands are ranked first, second or third in their categories, and our manufacturers and pastry chefs have an enviable mission to create and manufacture chocolate, cookies, crackers and candy in our iconic factories and locations across Ontario. A company with many ambitious growth targets, we have invested close to $250 million in our Ontario plants in recent years alone; We run marketing campaigns promoting innovative products such as Cadbury Dark Milk tablets and OREO Birthday Cake and Peppermint Bark cookies. Title: Undersheriff
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**
--------------------

Serves as the second-in-command and chief executive officer for the day-to-day operations of the Pueblo County Sheriff’s Office. Responsible for coordinating, planning, directing, and evaluating all divisions and functions to ensure effective, lawful, efficient, and community-focused service delivery. Acts with full authority in the absence of the Pueblo County Sheriff and exercises command authority over all personnel. This position is appointed by and serves at the discretion of the Sheriff.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

Exercises direct, first-level supervision of positions, employees, operations, and activities. Includes coordinating staff training, assigning and reviewing work, participating in the interview and selection process, making recommendations impacting pay, status, and disciplinary action, evaluating performance independently or in conjunction with a higher-level supervisor/manager, and approving time off and approving staff timesheets.
  
  
Oversees hiring, discipline, evaluations, and workforce planning. Directs Internal Affairs and professional standards investigations. Ensures fair and legally sound resolution of personnel matters. Develops and mentors command staff and promotes succession planning.
  
  
Directs, coordinates, and evaluates operations across all divisions. Provides executive leadership to command staff and establishes strategic direction. Ensures compliance with all laws, regulations, and accreditation standards. Serves as acting Sheriff in the Sheriff’s absence.
  
  
Analyzes operational and crime data to improve performance. Evaluates effectiveness of programs and services. Leads planning, research, and implementation of best practices. Commands major incidents and emergency operations.
  
  
Oversees budget development and administration. Allocates personnel and financial resources effectively. Supports grants and external funding opportunities.
  
  
Represents the Sheriff’s Office in public and professional settings. Maintains relationships with partner agencies and stakeholders. Serves as liaison for media and community engagement.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**
-----------------

**Residency:** Current resident status in the State of Colorado is required at the time of application. Selected candidate must be able to start on January 12, 2027.

**Education and Experience:** A high school diploma or GED is required. A bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, public administration, business administration, or closely related field is preferred. Five (5) years or more of administrative and management experience at the command level is required. Five (5) years or more of supervisory experience in law enforcement is required. *The substitution of any combination of relevant and related education, training, and/or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and ability may be considered.*

**License and Certification:** A valid Colorado driver’s license and Colorado POST certification are required upon the date of hire. Successful completion of the FBI National Academy or Command Staff School equivalent is required within one (1) year of hire.

  
  

**Additional Information** The selection process includes, but is not limited to, an interview. Prior to employment, candidates will complete a background investigation, polygraph examination, physical examination, and psychological examination. The expected duration of the selection process is less than two months. Candidates not selected may reapply in the future.

**Classification title:** Administrative Assistant 2

**Program:** Community Health Center

**Division:** Bridger & Joliet Clinics

**Reports to:** Clinic Manager Joliet/Bridger

**FLSA status:** Non-Exempt- Full time

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday; 8am to 5pm

**Wage Range:** $20.32 to $22.84 hourly; depending on number of years of transferrable experience and internal equity.

### **Organization Overview:**

Serving the Yellowstone County community and south-central Montana for nearly 50 years, RiverStone Health is an essential provider of personal and public health services. Health, Education, Leadership and Protection – HELP is what we do.

From medical, dental and behavioral healthcare; home care and hospice; public health services like immunizations, WIC, health promotion and restaurant inspections; and educating the next generation of health professionals, our expertise spans all ages and stages of life. Underlying principles of access, affordability, compassion and quality in all interactions, RiverStone Health improves life, health and safety for all of the communities we serve.

### **Job Summary:**

This position is responsible for providing excellent customer service to RiverStone Health clients over the phone and in person. Duties include scheduling, collecting and entering patient information, answering questions and referring clients to appropriate resources and people. The work environment is typically fast paced. Work is performed with integrity and innovation to ensure a high level of customer service delivery.

### **Essential Functions/Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

Patient Access Services 85%

* Compassionate, friendly, and professional customer communications in person, over the phone and in writing.
* Collect, prepare, and enter data accurately into multiple database systems in a timely manner.
* Provide patient services, which may include greeting, check-ins, making appointments, rescheduling, follow-ups, outreach, medical records requests, and escorting patients to applicable service areas.
* Provide administrative services, which may include mail distribution, requesting payment of services, money handling, preparing deposit paperwork, answering and routing calls, scanning patient documents, and preparing correspondence.
* Review and provide information to outside entities ensuring that all confidentiality and HIPAA policies and procedures are followed.
* Excellent internal communication with other RiverStone employees, and providers to ensure efficiencies and quality customer service.
* Willingness and ability to ensure excellent work, support of others and participate in quality improvement processes.
* Refer customers to other RiverStone programs and community services as needed.
* Perform patient outreach for care coordination and follow-up on testing or treatment.
* Comprehensive medical records review
* Prepare and coordinate special projects as needed.
* Resolve problems and concerns, and report issues and incidents using RiverStone processes.
* Keep public facing areas clean and tidy.
* Attend staff and educational meetings.
* Represent RiverStone Health in meetings, trainings or public events when needed.

[Discipline or program-specific duties] 10%

* May have to help clean exam rooms and/or move equipment around in exam rooms to get ready for the patients.
* May be asked to help cover staffing needs at the Joliet RiverStone Health Clinic.

### **Non-Essential Functions/Other duties as assigned** **5%**

Perform other duties as assigned in support of RiverStone Health’s mission and goals.

### **Education and Experience:**

Minimum Qualifications

* High School diploma or equivalent
* Administrative experience in a medical setting
* EHR experience
* Medical terminology training or experience
* Any combination of experience and training which provide the equivalent scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working with underserved population
* Experience working in a customer service environment

### **Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:**

* CPR/BLS Certification- If not CPR/BLS certified upon hire, you will be required to become CPR/BLS certified and RiverStone will provide the training.

### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Computer literacy, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Ability to maintain a calm and positive demeanor during difficult client interactions.
* Ability to display non-judgmental and empathetic listening skills.
* High degree of detail-oriented skill level.
* Knowledge and understanding of protected sensitive patient health information (HIPAA) and confidentiality.
* Ability to work collaboratively and maintain a positive work environment.
* Ability to meet deadlines.
* Team player.

### **Customer Service Excellence:**

* Doing things right the first time
* Making people feel welcome
* Showing respect for each customer
* Anticipating customer needs and concerns
* Keeping customers informed
* Helping and going the extra mile
* Responding quickly
* Protecting privacy and confidentiality
* Demonstrating proper telephone etiquette
* Taking responsibility for handling complaints
* Being professional
* Taking ownership of your attitude toward Service Excellence.

### **Supervision:**

None

### **Physical Demands and Working Conditions:**

* Work is mainly performed on a computer up to 10 hours per day.
* Work is performed at 2 locations. Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday in Bridger. Tuesday and Friday in Joliet
* This position may require occasional travel to different clinic locations, typically 1-2 times per month.
* Create and maintain a safe/secure working environment by adhering to safety, security, and health requirements. Integrates injury, illness, and loss prevention into job activities by attending any necessary training and implementing best practices.

### **Freedom to Act & Decision Making:**

Work is structured by public health regulations and established medical practices. Decisions directly affect the quality of services provided to the public.

Not applicable

Title: Physical Therapy Assistant - Part-Time
Description:
**Join the Rivetus Team!**

Rivetus has been serving the geriatric post-acute community since 1998. We are a specialized rehabilitation company operated and managed at the executive level by licensed clinicians. Our unique perspective combines superior knowledge of the healthcare regulatory industry with a passion for positive patient outcomes. We incorporate solid business practices with skill and compassion to provide superior service, expedite healing, and enhance the quality of life for patients recovering in skilled nursing facilities.  
  
**Facility Location: Fountain Bleu 28910 Plymouth Road Livonia, MI 48150**  
**Schedule: Part-Time, Flexible Scheduling Available**

**General Summary:**  
Provides physical therapy treatment to patients according to the established treatment plan under the supervision of the Physical Therapist. Contributes to the development, implementation of, and progression of patient treatment and modifies treatment as necessary. Participates in patient care conferences and program development. Completes appropriate documentation and adheres to policies, procedures and current standards of clinical practice.  
  
**Role Summary**:

* Provides physical therapy treatments consistent with the professional and ethical standards of the A.P.T.A. for the Physical Therapist Assistant.
* Provides documentation to maintain quality of the medical record as it relates to accuracy, continuity of care and reimbursement guidelines.
* Coordinates with other disciplines for effective total patient care.
* Assures delivery of quality care.
* Participates in the discharge planning process to ensure continued patient care as needed and provide patient and family instruction.
* Maintains the clinical expertise of the PTA through continuing education.
* Contributes to a team philosophy within the department and the company and promotes the same among staff.
* Delegates work assignments, responsibilities, and patients to support staff as needed.
* Supervises students and volunteers.
* Represents the Physical Therapy Department to family, visitors, and personnel and attends care conferences as requested.
* Effectively communicates with department staff, company personnel, patients and families and department head.
* Secures equipment for patients and department supplies as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Successful completion of an accredited Physical Therapy Assistant program
* Licensure as required by the State of Michigan

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to exercise professional judgement and initiative when analyzing problems and recommending solutions.
* Initiative and flexibility in the work environment.
* Ability to react effectively to the needs of patients and their families.
* Physical Ability to bend, position, transfer and lift patients weighing from 80 pounds to over 300 pounds, without restriction, utilizing lifting devices clinically recommended for the patient.

**Employee Benefits:**

* Competitive Pay
* 401k Eligibility & matching after 3 months of service.
* Reimbursement for Professional Licensure.

Title: Tier 2 Customer Experience Agent
Description:
**Who We Are**

At BlueCosmo, we keep people connected where cell coverage ends. From remote adventures to critical business operations, we provide satellite phones, messengers, and data solutions that help people stay connected when it matters most.

As a Roadpost brand, we partner with leading satellite networks, including Iridium and Inmarsat, and offer trusted products like ZOLEO. But we’re more than just a hardware retailer; our business is built on lasting subscriber relationships, with recurring airtime services at the heart of what we do.

We’re focused on growing that connection – bringing new customers on board, keeping existing subscribers engaged, and delivering reliable communication beyond the reach of cellular networks.

**Why This Role Matters**

We sell satellite telephony — Iridium phones, Inmarsat handsets, GO devices, SIM cards, and airtime plans. AI handles the straightforward volume. What reaches you is the stuff that actually needs a human: a phone that won't connect in the field, a SIM that isn't provisioning, a customer who needs to be in the right plan before they fly out tomorrow. The problems that reach you are telephony-based — power, signal acquisition, dialing, SIM provisioning, airtime balances, number management, and device configuration.

Reporting to the MSS Team Lead, you own those issues start to finish, and you take the initiative to pick up what's next. The customers who contact us depend on their satellite device for continuity of communication — sometimes in genuinely remote or high-risk situations. That urgency is part of the job.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Ownership and continuity of communication.** This is the headline quality we hire for. Take the ticket, work it, close it. Customers in the field cannot afford gaps in coverage — that reality should drive how you prioritize. If you can't resolve something, you find out how. You take the lead on the next step rather than waiting for a manager to assign it, point you to a call, or explain what needs to be done. This role is a great fit for people who enjoy that kind of independence.
* **Product and service knowledge.** Know every product we sell and what it does: Iridium and Inmarsat satellite phones, Iridium GO, Beam and ASE docking stations, SIM cards, airtime plans, and the full range of antenna and cabling configurations. Occasionally you'll help customers who are still figuring out what they need — comparing plans, asking about coverage, or deciding between devices. You're not selling; you're helping them land on the right answer. That means knowing our products well enough to give a confident, accurate recommendation without a script.
* **Self-direction and problem solving.** Box in the issue before you start solving it. Triage properly — eliminate what it isn't before you decide what it is. Use the web, manufacturer documentation, forums, and AI tools to find answers. Curiosity and a drive to learn are essential in this role. When a fix doesn't work, you try a new angle rather than repeating the same step. When you genuinely can't resolve something, you escalate with a full brief and still own the customer interaction to closure.
* **Working with AI.** You'll use AI every day — to research problems, find solutions, and learn faster. You'll also judge whether an AI response to a customer is actually right, and flag to our Optimization team when it isn't. When you spot a repeat issue across tickets that could be automated or handled without a human, you bring it forward. We want people who ask how this could be solved at the system level, because improving the AI's handling of common issues is part of how this team succeeds. That contribution is valued here.
* **Knowledge base contribution.** When you solve something new, or find that an existing article is wrong or missing, you document it. KB articles and updated SOPs are part of your output. The team's collective knowledge is only as good as what gets written down.
* **On-call rotation.** You'll rotate for after-hours emergencies and periodic weekend ticket handling alongside the rest of the team — a handful of incidents per month at most. These are real situations: a customer whose satellite phone stopped working the night before a remote expedition, or a vessel that's lost communications.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience.** 3–5 years in wireless, satellite, or telecom customer support — Tier 2 or equivalent experience
* **Technical Troubleshooting.** Comfortable with telephony troubleshooting: signal, SIM provisioning, number management, dialing issues, firmware, antenna and cabling configurations
* **Self-Starter.** Demonstrably self-directed — you find answers without being told where to look
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication — clear, accurate, and direct with customers
* **Ticketing Tools.** Proficient with Zendesk or equivalent ticketing platform; CRM experience an asset
* **AI Fluency.** Experience using AI tools as a daily working resource, not just occasionally
* **Languages.** French language fluency a strong asset — bilingual candidates strongly preferred

**What We Offer**

* **Salary Range.** $62,000–$65,000 CAD base salary.
* **After-hours.** Separate compensation and plan for the after-hours and weekend on-call rotation.
* **Flexible Work.** A hybrid model; balancing collaboration and lifestyle flexibility, with scheduled shifts Monday to Friday between 9am–7pm ET within an availability window of 8am–8pm
* **Comprehensive Benefits.** Health, dental, and flexible spending accounts tailored to your needs.
* **Time to Recharge.** Vacation and sick days to help you rest, recharge, and stay well.
* **Growth Investment.** A continuous learning environment backed by a professional development budget.
* **Inclusive by Nature.** A values-driven workplace where diverse perspectives are celebrated.

**Apply Now**

Our recruitment process may use artificial intelligence tools, alongside human review, to assist with the screening or assessment of candidates.

We are currently hiring for this role and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace. If you meet around 70% of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply — we’d love to hear from you.  
  
We’re happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process; if you require support, please let us know when you apply, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs

Title: ELV & Starlink Installation Technician
Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

**Salary**

* To be decided in interview

The Specialist provides subject matter expertise on a grouping of applications, for either library services or corporate applications, and provides support in the selection and implementation of new applications. The Specialist is also responsible for on-going operational support, which includes problem/incident resolution, routine maintenance, and delivering on enhancement and change requests. The Specialist also supports application roadmap planning and is accountable for maintaining current awareness of vendor product development cycles. In supporting the application portfolio, this Specialist works with business stakeholders to ensure applications deliver value and are meeting business requirements for functionality, availability, and performance.

  

**Assignment:** Working knowledge and experience implementing and supporting Corporate Applications including but not limited to human capital management (HCM), learning management systems (LMS), incident reporting and management system (IRMS) and Microsoft collaboration technologies with proven experience in application configuration, data migration, data mapping and integrations with other systems, system administration and providing technical support.

* Partnering with business and technical groups to support ongoing business requirements.

* Ensuring all operational activities comply with enterprise, industry, and government standards.
* Creating and maintaining quality support documentation for assigned applications. Ensuring all application changes are thoroughly tested and implemented into production following the Library’s change management process.

* Researching, developing, testing and recommending process improvements and automation solutions for driving efficiencies, stability, cost savings

* Working closely with library vendors to resolve technical issues, facilitate application upgrades as part of the application life cycle management, and implement software enhancements while holding vendors accountable for contractual obligations and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Participating in regular team, project, business, and committee meetings.
* Evening, weekend and callback work may be required
* Performing other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Up to three years’ post-secondary education in the field of Information Technology
* Minimum of five (5) years related application support experience or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of enterprise-wide business and technical processes
* Proven experience working with designated current TPL applications (either Library or Corporate applications), as defined in the job posting e.g. , (ex. Ceridian HCM, Symphony ILS, Self-checkout, Collection Digitization, Cornerstone LMS, Dynamics GP Finance)
* Proven experience working within established enterprise architecture frameworks in large organizations
* Proven understanding of best practices for applications, data security and ITIL

* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects and assignments with high quality deliverables
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously including the ability to plan and organize work that is in alignment with projects and organizational deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders
* Ability to perform work requiring sound judgement, initiative, and analytical skills
* Ability to visit or work from over 100 Library branches across Toronto

Title: Electrical Superintendent F/H

a joint venture of multiple subsidiaries of the VINCI Group, construction worldwide leader, specialized in the design and construction of major civil engineering and building works in Canada is hiring an  
  
**Electrical Superintendent**

The Pickering Nuclear Generating Station refurbishment program involves designing and building a new deep-water intake in Lake Ontario to improve the plant's cooling system. This will involve:  
A 1.5 km-long tunnel, built by a pressurized TBM (10.5 m diameter slurry TBM);  
Two vertical shafts (onshore and offshore);  
An offshore modular intake structure, resting on the lake bed.

The electrical superintendent is part of the plant department and reports to the deputy plant manager and plant manager. * Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all electrical activities on the project.
* Responsible to setup, launch and develop electrical site installations for all sites
* Lead and supervise electrical foremen, electricians, technicians, and subcontractors engaged in the installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems
* Ensure all personnel working on electrical systems are adequately trained, qualified and authorized.

* Review and approve Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS), and electrical risk assessments

* Participate in incident investigations, root cause analyses, and implementation of corrective actions
* Coordinate electrical interfaces with tunnelling, shaft construction, ground treatment, soil processing, marine operations, and other project disciplines.
* Develop and monitor electrical work plans, schedules, resource requirements, and procurement activities.
* Ensure adequate temporary power distribution systems are installed, maintained, and adapted to evolving project needs.
* Act as the primary technical authority and point of contact for all project electrical matters.
* Ensure electrical installations comply with project specifications, applicable codes, standards, and engineering requirements.
* Verify completion of inspections, testing, commissioning, and acceptance procedures.
* Review and approve electrical shop drawings, technical submittals

**Your skills**

* Engineering Degree
* Solid knowledge of design and visualizations software such as AutoCAD or similar
* Strong knowledge of the Ontario Electrical Safety Code, Canadian
* Electrical Code, and applicable CSA standards
* Extensive experience supervising electrical construction and commissioning activities on industrial, infrastructure, mining, tunnelling, or heavy civil projects
* Experience with medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, power distribution, grounding, protection, and control systems.
* Experience with transformers, switchgear, substations, generators, motor control centres (MCCs), instrumentation, and control systems.
* Familiarity with commissioning processes and electrical testing protocols.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and construction contracts.
* Understanding of construction sequencing, logistics constraints, and temporary works requirements

What do we have to provide:

* Annual bonuses;
* Group Health Insurance (premium participation including virtual health care system);
* RRSP Program

Title: Product Solution Analyst
Description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

The Visa Direct is experiencing tremendous growth as we expand our cross border money movement solutions and use cases, while continuing to strengthen our range of payment solutions for financial institutions, fintechs, and commercial clients.

The Visa Direct Centre of Excellence (COE) plays a critical role in accelerating this growth by leading product solutioning activities across Visa Direct capabilities, including Cards, Accounts and Wallets

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Visa Direct Solutions team and contribute to the expansion of next-generation payment solutions across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman.

We are looking for a technically strong, proactive, and highly motivated Product Analyst who combines knowledge of payment technologies with excellent project management, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills.

The successful candidate will support client solutioning, technical integrations, and product deployments while taking ownership of assigned initiatives and driving them through to successful completion.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Why This Role Is Important to Visa:

As Visa expands beyond traditional consumer payments into domestic and cross-border money movement, successful client integration and adoption of new payment capabilities are critical to driving growth.

The Product Analyst will play an important role in supporting the deployment of Visa Direct solutions across financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, and other ecosystem participants.

The role requires an individual who can bridge business and technology, understand complex payment flows, manage multiple stakeholders, and proactively drive initiatives forward.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

Product Solutioning & Technical Support:

* Support end-to-end product solutioning for Visa Direct capabilities, from technical presales and requirements gathering through solution design, integration, testing, and commercial launch.
* Work closely with clients to understand their business requirements, technical environments, and integration needs.
* Support technical solution workshops and guide clients on integrating Visa Direct products into their existing payment infrastructure.
* Develop a strong understanding of Visa Direct APIs and payment capabilities across cards, accounts, wallets, and cross-border solutions.
* Apply knowledge of card payments, tokenization, banking payment rails, SWIFT messaging, cross-border payment flows, and payment processing to support client solution design.
* Assist with API integration, technical validation, testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
* Prepare and review technical documentation, including payment flows, API specifications, solution architecture diagrams, and sequence diagrams.
* Collaborate with internal Product and Technology teams to address technical challenges and identify appropriate solutions.
* Stay informed about product enhancements, emerging payment technologies, and new capabilities relevant to the markets.

Project Management & Delivery Ownership:

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned initiatives, ensuring activities progress from initiation through successful delivery.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, action trackers, and implementation status reports.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion of deliverables and resolution of dependencies.
* Proactively identify project risks, technical blockers, and potential delays, and drive timely resolution.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivery quality.
* Ensure clear accountability, timely follow-ups, and effective communication across stakeholders.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately while proposing practical solutions and recommendations.
* Demonstrate a strong bias toward execution, accountability, and achieving measurable outcomes.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement:

* Engage with financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, technology partners, and other ecosystem participants.
* Support client discussions and technical workshops, translating business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Prepare and confidently present project updates, technical findings, and recommendations to management and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Product, Technology, Implementation, Client Services, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams.
* Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills to align teams and manage competing priorities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman.

Product Analysis & Continuous Improvement:

* Analyze client requirements, technical challenges, and product gaps to identify opportunities for enhancement.
* Support the documentation, assessment, and prioritization of product improvement requests.
* Contribute to reusable technical documentation, solution playbooks, and implementation best practices.
* Identify opportunities to simplify integration processes, improve client onboarding, and accelerate time to market.
* Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve technical analysis, documentation, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Visa Direct Solutions Centre of Excellence.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional product or solutioning experience in payments, banking, fintech, payment processing, or technical product.

* Understanding of SWIFT messaging and cross-border payment concepts, flows, and ecosystem participants.
* Strong Project Management skills.
* Proficiency in Arabic, with strong verbal communication skills for client and stakeholder engagement across the KBO markets.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Title: BOLD & GOLD Logistics Coordinator
Description:
Overview:

**Our Commitment to Equity**

The Y actively promotes a culture free from bias and injustice. We are dedicated to removing institutional and systemic barriers that result in oppression and racism. We will be accountable to marginalized communities for creating equitable and sustainable environments where social justice is woven into every facet of our programs, and by caring for our communities in a culturally versatile and respectful manner.

**Compensation:** $125.00-$143.00/day

**Tell Me About This Job!**

As Logistics Coordinator, your role is to work in collaboration with the BOLD & GOLD seasonal and full-time team. You will work closely with our Operations Manager and Logistics Manager to ensure that instructors and participants are provided with the necessary resources to be successful. This could be in the form of packing food, repairing equipment, driving, playing games with youth, or consoling a homesick participant. This position provides an excellent opportunity to obtain field experience and a better understanding of working with youth outdoors.

**BOLD & GOLD** is dedicated to inspiring courage and confidence in diverse groups of youth through outdoor adventures. As a program of the Camping & Outdoor Leadership branch of the YMCA of Greater Seattle, BOLD & GOLD offers year-round partnership programs and summer expedition experiences. Partnership programs engage with schools, non-profits, and community-based organizations to design and implement transformative outdoor experiences. The summer expedition program runs single-gender and all-gender expeditions that engage youth through frontcountry and backcountry trips ranging in length from 5 to 15 days. BOLD & GOLD experiences take place in Mt Rainier National Park, North Cascades National Park, Olympic National Park, National Forests, Washington State Parks, and local green spaces. Activities include backpacking, rock climbing, kayaking, snowshoeing, fishing, art, and teambuilding. The goal of BOLD & GOLD is to increase confidence, courage, emotional intelligence, wonder, and community awareness in our participants. BOLD & GOLD believes these traits are the foundations of leadership and works to inspire participants to develop their own leadership style. BOLD & GOLD prepares young people to be the next generation of leaders through multicultural experiential education in the natural world.

Find out more at www.seattleymca.org/boldgold.

**What You'll Get From Working at the Y**

* Individual membership to the YMCA of Greater Seattle.
* Free access to mental health resources.
* Rapidly accruing paid time off (PTO)
* Subsidized ORCA Transit Pass.
* Access to discounted gear and equipment through pro deals.

Responsibilities:

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Coordinate the organization, function, and availability of backpacking, camping, and rock-climbing equipment, including clothing, first aid supplies, stoves, backpacks, sleeping bags, and tents.
* Collaborate with staff to pack and prepare all field-going food and equipment.
* Facilitate and provide support to instructor teams during the trip prep, de-issue, and debrief process.
* Model cultural humility and celebrate diversity, effectively working with people of different identities, backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
* Ensure both a physically and an emotionally safe and inclusive environment for youth and staff.
* Other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Environment**

BOLD & GOLD is based out of the Cascade People’s Center (CPC), located in Seattle, WA. BOLD & GOLD courses begin and end at the CPC. BOLD & GOLD programming takes place in remote wilderness locations (national park, national forest, state park land) across Washington State.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Employees must be able to lift and carry items weighing up to 50lbs, safely travel over varied terrain (trails, tree roots, boulder/rock fields, shoreline, mud, snow, ice) up to 15 miles per day, be comfortable spending multiple days and/or weeks in a wilderness setting, communicate both verbally and non-verbally with other staff, volunteers, and participants. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work**  
This is a seasonal exempt position, and staff are paid a daily rate. Logistics Coordinators will work approximately 40-50 hours per week on a Thursday-Monday schedule. Approximate schedule will be from late May- early September. This includes Logistics Team training, Backcountry Skills Training, and All Staff Training.

**Travel**

BOLD & GOLD employees must be able to commute to the Cascade People’s Center, 309 Pontius Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109. Parking is not available onsite, but there is paid public parking located around the building. The area is serviced by several public bus routes. All travel required for work will be done in YMCA vehicles.

Code of Conduct for Applicants

**All employees and volunteers are responsible for adhering to abuse prevention policies, maintaining appropriate boundaries, completing required training, reporting suspicious or inappropriate behavior, and complying with mandated reporting requirements.**

**Responsible for ensuring staff are properly screened, trained, supervised and held accountable to the organization’s abuse risk management standards.**

Qualifications:

**What We're Looking for in an Applicant**

* Wilderness trip experience as either a participant or staff member.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team.
* Desire to learn and approach challenges with a problem-solving mentality.
* High level of self-awareness and can work in a collaborative setting.
* Commitment to working with diverse groups of youth and staff.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Other applicable education, training, and experience, which provide the knowledge, abilities, and skills necessary to perform effectively in the position will be considered.
* Current WFA and CPR Certification\*
* Current Washington State Food Handlers Permit\*
* Leave No Trace 101 Certification\*

* Required by start date

**This Position Requires Driving**

BOLD & GOLD uses 14-passenger minibuses to transport passengers and equipment to trailheads and campsites, including driving on interstates, city streets, and rural roads.

**Driving Duties Requirement**

This role transports clients as an “authorized driver” for the YMCA of Greater Seattle (YGS) using an employer-provided vehicle. **Driving duties for this role are Required.** Driving roles are safety-sensitive. To become an authorized driver, you must be 21+, have possessed a driver's license for at least 3 years, and pass a drug screen that will test for impairing substances (including marijuana) in addition to meeting the driving record standards below:

**YGS Driving Record Standards**

**Within the last three (3) years:** No more than two (2) vehicle related suspension(s) and/or reinstatement(s). No more than two (2) moving violations and/or accidents. Moving violations include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Speeding
* Improper Lane Change
* Failure to Yield in Right-of-Way
* Failure to Obey Traffic Signal
* Failure to obey Traffic Sign

**Within the last five (5) years:** No Major Violations which include, but are not limited to, the following:

* DUI, DWI, OUI, OWI, BUI (Boating), Administrative Per Se, or Refusing to Test
